WITH school_rates AS (
  SELECT
    cds,
    CAST(NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_excellence_rate
  FROM satscores
  WHERE rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT MAX(f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_ages_5_17_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN school_rates AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE s.sat_excellence_rate > 0.3;

SELECT
  "School Name",
  "Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm
WHERE "County Name" = 'Los Angeles'
  AND "Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND "High Grade" = '9'
ORDER BY "School Name";

SELECT f."Percent (%) Eligible Free (K-12)" AS percent_eligible_free_k12,
       f."District Code" AS district_code
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.AdmFName1 = 'Alusine';

SELECT s.School, s.MailStreet, s.MailCity, s.MailState, s.MailZip, ss.AvgScrRead
FROM schools AS s
JOIN satscores AS ss ON ss.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
  AND ss.rtype = 'S'
  AND ss.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.AvgScrRead = (
    SELECT MAX(ss2.AvgScrRead)
    FROM schools AS s2
    JOIN satscores AS ss2 ON ss2.cds = s2.CDSCode
    WHERE s2.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
      AND ss2.rtype = 'S'
      AND ss2.AvgScrRead IS NOT NULL
  )

SELECT s.City FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.CDSCode = '01611920113902'
  AND s.County = 'Alameda'
  AND s.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" LIKE '%Provision 2%';

WITH statewide AS (
  SELECT s.School, s.Phone, x.NumGE1500
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS x ON x.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.Charter = 1
    AND s.DOCType = 'Statewide Benefit Charter'
)
SELECT School, Phone, NumGE1500
FROM statewide
WHERE NumGE1500 = (SELECT MAX(NumGE1500) FROM statewide);

WITH target AS (
  SELECT NumTstTakr
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds = '7618040730051'
),
county_schools AS (
  SELECT s.cds, s.NumTstTakr
  FROM satscores AS s
  JOIN schools AS sch ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
  WHERE sch.County = 'Contra Costa'
    AND s.rtype = 'S'
)
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM county_schools
WHERE NumTstTakr > (SELECT NumTstTakr FROM target);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM schools AS sch
JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.MailCity = 'San Francisco'
  AND sch.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND f."District Type" IN (
    'Unified School District',
    'High School District',
    'Elementary School District',
    'County Office of Education (COE)'
  )
  AND sat.AvgScrRead + sat.AvgScrMath + sat.AvgScrWrite >= 1500;

WITH grade_starts AS (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN GSserved LIKE 'P%' THEN 'P'
    WHEN GSserved LIKE 'TK%' THEN 'TK'
    WHEN GSserved LIKE 'K%' THEN 'K'
    WHEN GSserved GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(substr(GSserved, 1, 1) AS INTEGER)
  END AS start_grade
  FROM schools
  WHERE NCESDist = '0632640'
    AND StatusType = 'Active'
    AND GSserved IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT CASE MIN(
  CASE start_grade
    WHEN 'P' THEN -2
    WHEN 'TK' THEN -1
    WHEN 'K' THEN 0
    ELSE start_grade
  END
)
  WHEN -2 THEN 'P'
  WHEN -1 THEN 'TK'
  WHEN 0 THEN 'K'
  ELSE CAST(MIN(
    CASE start_grade
      WHEN 'P' THEN -2
      WHEN 'TK' THEN -1
      WHEN 'K' THEN 0
      ELSE start_grade
    END
  ) AS TEXT)
END AS lowest_grade
FROM grade_starts;

WITH youth_authority AS (
  SELECT CDSCode
  FROM schools
  WHERE SOCType = 'Youth Authority Facilities'
),
per_school AS (
  SELECT
    y.CDSCode,
    COALESCE(MAX(f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"), 0) AS eligible_count
  FROM youth_authority AS y
  LEFT JOIN frpm AS f
    ON f.CDSCode = y.CDSCode
   AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
  GROUP BY y.CDSCode
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(eligible_count), 2)
FROM per_school;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    s.School,
    s.AdmEmail1,
    t.NumGE1500,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC) AS rank_num
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS t
    ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Board of Education'
    AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT School, AdmEmail1
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_num = 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0)), 2) AS avg_sat_test_takers_per_school
FROM schools AS sch
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = sch.CDSCode
WHERE sch.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND sch.OpenDate >= '2007-01-01'
  AND sch.OpenDate < '2008-01-01'
  AND sch.DOCType IN (
    'County Office of Education (COE)',
    'Elementary School District',
    'High School District',
    'Unified School District'
  );

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    s.CDSCode,
    s.School,
    f."Low Grade" AS earliest_grade,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    COALESCE(sa.NumTstTakr, 0) AS sat_test_takers,
    CASE f."Low Grade"
      WHEN 'P' THEN 0 WHEN 'K' THEN 1
      WHEN '1' THEN 2 WHEN '2' THEN 3 WHEN '3' THEN 4
      WHEN '4' THEN 5 WHEN '5' THEN 6 WHEN '6' THEN 7
      WHEN '7' THEN 8 WHEN '8' THEN 9 WHEN '9' THEN 10
      WHEN '10' THEN 11 WHEN '11' THEN 12 WHEN '12' THEN 13
      ELSE -1
    END AS grade_order
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS sa ON sa.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools'
    AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015'
)
SELECT
  School AS school_name,
  earliest_grade,
  enrollment_k12,
  sat_test_takers
FROM candidates
ORDER BY grade_order DESC, enrollment_k12 DESC, School COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH funding_types AS (
  SELECT 'Directly funded' AS funding_type, 1 AS sort_order
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Locally funded only', 2
),
frpm_by_school AS (
  SELECT
    CDSCode,
    "Charter Funding Type" AS funding_type,
    MAX("Enrollment (K-12)") AS enrollment_k12,
    MAX("FRPM Count (K-12)") AS frpm_eligible_k12
  FROM frpm
  WHERE "District Type" = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
    AND "Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
    AND "Charter Funding Type" IN ('Directly funded', 'Locally funded')
  GROUP BY CDSCode, "Charter Funding Type"
)
SELECT
  ft.funding_type AS charter_funding_type,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Active' THEN 1 END) AS currently_operating_schools,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Active' THEN f.enrollment_k12 ELSE 0 END) AS total_k12_enrollment,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.StatusType = 'Active' THEN f.frpm_eligible_k12 ELSE 0 END) AS total_frpm_eligible_k12_students
FROM funding_types ft
LEFT JOIN frpm_by_school f
  ON f.funding_type = CASE
    WHEN ft.funding_type = 'Locally funded only' THEN 'Locally funded'
    ELSE ft.funding_type
  END
LEFT JOIN schools s
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
 AND s.DOCType = 'County Office of Education (COE)'
 AND s.Charter = 1
 AND s.FundingType = CASE
    WHEN ft.funding_type = 'Locally funded only' THEN 'Locally funded'
    ELSE ft.funding_type
  END
GROUP BY ft.funding_type, ft.sort_order
ORDER BY ft.sort_order;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    sc.School AS school_name,
    sc.District AS district,
    sc.County AS county,
    sat.AvgScrWrite AS avg_sat_writing
  FROM schools AS sc
  JOIN satscores AS sat
    ON sat.cds = sc.CDSCode
  WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Closed'
    AND sat.AvgScrWrite IS NOT NULL
),
runner_up AS (
  SELECT MAX(avg_sat_writing) AS score
  FROM eligible
  WHERE avg_sat_writing < (SELECT MAX(avg_sat_writing) FROM eligible)
)
SELECT
  e.school_name,
  e.district,
  e.county,
  e.avg_sat_writing
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN runner_up AS r
  ON e.avg_sat_writing = r.score
ORDER BY e.school_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS schools_with_zero_sat_test_takers
FROM schools AS s
LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat
  ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
 AND sat.rtype = 'S'
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.State = 'CA'
  AND s.EILName = 'High School'
  AND COALESCE(sat.NumTstTakr, 0) = 0;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%m', OpenDate) AS month, COUNT(*) AS openings
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'San Diego'
    AND OpenDate >= '1980-01-01'
    AND OpenDate < '1981-01-01'
    AND DOCType IN (
      'Elementary School District',
      'High School District',
      'Unified School District'
    )
  GROUP BY strftime('%m', OpenDate)
)
SELECT CAST(COALESCE(SUM(openings), 0) AS INTEGER) || '/12' AS exact_average
FROM monthly;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.CDSCode, s.Virtual
  FROM schools AS s
  JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat.cds = s.CDSCode
  WHERE s.State = 'CA'
    AND sat.AvgScrMath > 400
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Virtual IN ('F', 'P') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  1
) AS percentage
FROM eligible;

WITH sat AS (
  SELECT cds, sname, dname, cname, NumTstTakr, AvgScrRead, AvgScrMath, AvgScrWrite, NumGE1500
  FROM satscores
  WHERE cds = '1612590137943'
),
school AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1612590137943'
)
SELECT
  sat.cds AS cds_code,
  COALESCE(school.School, sat.sname) AS school_name,
  COALESCE(school.County, sat.cname) AS county,
  COALESCE(school.District, sat.dname) AS district,
  school.City AS city,
  NULL AS enrollment_k12,
  NULL AS frpm_count_k12,
  NULL AS percent_eligible_frpm_k12,
  sat.NumTstTakr AS sat_test_takers,
  sat.AvgScrRead AS average_reading_score,
  sat.AvgScrMath AS average_math_score,
  sat.AvgScrWrite AS average_writing_score,
  sat.NumGE1500 AS test_takers_total_at_least_1500
FROM sat
LEFT JOIN school ON school.CDSCode = sat.cds;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    s."School" AS school_name,
    f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (K-12)", 0) AS free_meal_rate,
    f."Charter School (Y/N)" AS charter,
    s."GSserved" AS grades_served,
    CASE
      WHEN sat."AvgScrRead" IS NULL OR sat."AvgScrMath" IS NULL OR sat."AvgScrWrite" IS NULL
        THEN 'No SAT Data'
      WHEN sat."AvgScrRead" + sat."AvgScrMath" + sat."AvgScrWrite" < 1200
        THEN 'Below Average'
      WHEN sat."AvgScrRead" + sat."AvgScrMath" + sat."AvgScrWrite" <= 1500
        THEN 'Average'
      ELSE 'Above Average'
    END AS sat_performance
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN schools AS s ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS sat ON sat."cds" = f."CDSCode"
  WHERE f."County Name" = 'Alameda'
    AND f."School Type" = 'High Schools (Public)'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
    AND s."GSserved" IS NOT NULL
    AND CAST(substr(s."GSserved", 1, instr(s."GSserved", '-') - 1) AS INTEGER) <= 12
    AND CAST(substr(s."GSserved", instr(s."GSserved", '-') + 1) AS INTEGER) = 12
)
SELECT
  school_name,
  ROUND(free_meal_rate, 4) AS free_meal_rate,
  CASE
    WHEN charter = 1 THEN 'Yes'
    WHEN charter = 0 THEN 'No'
    ELSE 'Unknown'
  END AS charter_school,
  grades_served,
  sat_performance
FROM eligible
WHERE free_meal_rate = (SELECT MAX(free_meal_rate) FROM eligible)
ORDER BY school_name;

WITH virtual_schools AS (
  SELECT CDSCode, County, School
  FROM schools
  WHERE Virtual = 'F'
),
county_counts AS (
  SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS exclusively_virtual_school_count
  FROM virtual_schools
  GROUP BY County
),
ranked_counties AS (
  SELECT
    County,
    exclusively_virtual_school_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY exclusively_virtual_school_count DESC) AS county_rank
  FROM county_counts
),
school_reading AS (
  SELECT
    v.County,
    v.School,
    s.AvgScrRead,
    MAX(s.AvgScrRead) OVER (PARTITION BY v.County) AS highest_reading
  FROM virtual_schools AS v
  LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
    ON s.cds = v.CDSCode
),
best_schools AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    County,
    CASE WHEN highest_reading IS NULL THEN 'None' ELSE School END AS school_name
  FROM school_reading
  WHERE highest_reading IS NULL OR AvgScrRead = highest_reading
)
SELECT
  r.County AS county_name,
  r.exclusively_virtual_school_count,
  b.school_name AS highest_average_reading_school
FROM ranked_counties AS r
JOIN best_schools AS b
  ON b.County = r.County
WHERE r.county_rank <= 5
ORDER BY
  r.exclusively_virtual_school_count DESC,
  r.County,
  b.school_name;

WITH target_counties AS (
  SELECT County
  FROM schools
  WHERE County = 'Santa Barbara'

  UNION

  SELECT County
  FROM schools
  WHERE CDSCode = '1100170109835'
),
county_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tc.County,
    COUNT(s.CDSCode) AS exclusive_virtual_school_count
  FROM target_counties AS tc
  LEFT JOIN schools AS s
    ON s.County = tc.County
   AND s.Virtual = 'F'
  GROUP BY tc.County
)
SELECT County, exclusive_virtual_school_count
FROM county_counts
ORDER BY exclusive_virtual_school_count DESC, County ASC;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    f."CDSCode" AS cds,
    s."School" AS school_name,
    s."County" AS county,
    s."City" AS city,
    s."MailStreet" AS mailing_street,
    s."MailCity" AS mailing_city,
    s."MailState" AS mailing_state,
    s."MailZip" AS mailing_zip,
    s."Website" AS website,
    f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS enrollment_k12,
    f."FRPM Count (K-12)" AS frpm_eligible_count,
    f."Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)" AS frpm_share,
    CASE
      WHEN st."NumTstTakr" > 0
      THEN st."AvgScrRead" + st."AvgScrMath" + st."AvgScrWrite"
    END AS avg_total_sat,
    CASE
      WHEN st."NumTstTakr" > 0
      THEN 100.0 * st."NumGE1500" / st."NumTstTakr"
    END AS pct_sat_1500_plus,
    s."OpenDate" AS opening_date,
    CASE
      WHEN s."ClosedDate" IS NOT NULL THEN 'closed'
      ELSE 'open'
    END AS status
  FROM frpm f
  JOIN schools s ON s."CDSCode" = f."CDSCode"
  LEFT JOIN satscores st ON st.cds = f."CDSCode"
  WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 100
    AND f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 0
    AND s."Charter" = 0
    AND s."StatusType" = 'Active'
),
max_count AS (
  SELECT MAX(frpm_eligible_count) AS val FROM eligible
),
min_share AS (
  SELECT MIN(frpm_share) AS val FROM eligible
),
selected AS (
  SELECT 'largest FRPM-eligible count' AS part, e.*
  FROM eligible e
  JOIN max_count m ON e.frpm_eligible_count = m.val

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'smallest FRPM share' AS part, e.*
  FROM eligible e
  JOIN min_share m ON e.frpm_share = m.val

  UNION ALL

  SELECT 'the CDS code from my notes' AS part, e.*
  FROM eligible e
  WHERE e.cds = '4615150435602'
)
SELECT
  part,
  school_name,
  county,
  city,
  mailing_street,
  mailing_city,
  mailing_state,
  mailing_zip,
  website,
  enrollment_k12,
  frpm_eligible_count,
  frpm_share,
  avg_total_sat,
  pct_sat_1500_plus,
  opening_date,
  status
FROM selected
ORDER BY
  CASE part
    WHEN 'largest FRPM-eligible count' THEN 1
    WHEN 'smallest FRPM share' THEN 2
    ELSE 3
  END,
  school_name;

SELECT
  s.School AS school_name,
  s.Street AS street_address
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s
  ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."School Name" IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(f."School Name") <> ''
  AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" + 30
  AND CASE
        WHEN f."High Grade" = 'K' THEN 0
        WHEN f."High Grade" GLOB '[0-9]*' THEN CAST(f."High Grade" AS INTEGER)
        ELSE 999
      END <= 8;

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS REAL)
        - CAST(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS REAL) > 30
  AND CAST(f."Low Grade" AS INTEGER) >= 9
ORDER BY f.CDSCode ASC

WITH qualifying_schools AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    f.CDSCode,
    f."County Name" AS county_name
  FROM frpm AS f
  JOIN satscores AS s
    ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
  WHERE f."Academic Year" = '2014-15'
    AND f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0
    AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" / f."Enrollment (K-12)" > 0.1
    AND s.NumGE1500 > 0
)
SELECT
  county_name,
  COUNT(*) AS qualifying_school_count
FROM qualifying_schools
GROUP BY county_name
ORDER BY qualifying_school_count DESC, county_name ASC;

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS t
JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
WHERE t.NumTstTakr >= 700
  AND t.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
  AND t.NumTstTakr > 0
ORDER BY CAST(t.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / t.NumTstTakr ASC,
         CAST(t.cds AS INTEGER) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS magnet_schools_provision_2
FROM schools AS s
JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.Magnet = 1
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND s.City IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY s.City;

SELECT
  f."County Name" AS county_name,
  SUM(COALESCE(s.NumTstTakr, 0)) AS total_sat_test_takers
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN schools AS m
  ON m.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
LEFT JOIN satscores AS s
  ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Provision 2'
  AND m.Magnet = 1
GROUP BY f."County Name";

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS distinct_printings
FROM cards AS c
WHERE (c.power IS NULL OR c.power = '' OR instr(c.power, '*') > 0)
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM rulings AS r
    WHERE r.uuid = c.uuid
      AND lower(r.text) LIKE '%triggered ability%'
  )

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN fd.uuid IS NOT NULL THEN c.uuid END) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid), 2) AS percentage_with_french_translation
FROM cards AS c
LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
  ON fd.uuid = c.uuid AND LOWER(fd.language) = 'french'
WHERE c.power IS NULL OR TRIM(c.power) = '' OR c.power LIKE '%*%';

SELECT MAX(CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER)) - MIN(CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS years_between_frame_styles
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND c.frameVersion GLOB '[0-9]*';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
FROM cards c
WHERE c.borderColor = 'black'
  AND c.power IS NOT NULL
  AND c.power NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
  AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND c.availability LIKE '%mtgo%'

WITH translation_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(DISTINCT translation) AS translation_count
  FROM set_translations
  WHERE translation IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY setCode
),
card_counts AS (
  SELECT setCode, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM cards
  GROUP BY setCode
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0)), 0) AS total_cards
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN translation_counts AS tc ON tc.setCode = s.code
LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc ON cc.setCode = s.code
WHERE COALESCE(tc.translation_count, 0) < 5;

WITH translated_sets AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.type
    FROM sets AS s
    JOIN set_translations AS st
      ON st.setCode = s.code
    WHERE st.translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
),
translated_counts AS (
    SELECT ts.type,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ts.id) AS translated_set_count,
           COUNT(c.id) AS card_count
    FROM translated_sets AS ts
    JOIN sets AS s ON s.id = ts.id
    LEFT JOIN cards AS c ON c.setCode = s.code
    GROUP BY ts.type
)
SELECT types.type AS set_type,
       COALESCE(tc.translated_set_count, 0) AS translated_set_count,
       COALESCE(tc.card_count, 0) AS card_count
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT type FROM sets) AS types
LEFT JOIN translated_counts AS tc ON tc.type = types.type
ORDER BY types.type ASC;

WITH latest_date AS (
  SELECT MAX(r.date) AS ruling_date
  FROM rulings r
  JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
  WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings r
JOIN cards c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
JOIN latest_date d ON r.date = d.ruling_date
WHERE c.name = 'Mishra''s Factory';

WITH artist_counts AS (
  SELECT
    artist,
    COUNT(DISTINCT name) AS creature_card_count
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(artist) <> ''
    AND types LIKE '%Creature%'
  GROUP BY artist
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    artist,
    creature_card_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY creature_card_count DESC) AS rnk
  FROM artist_counts
)
SELECT artist, creature_card_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rnk = 1
ORDER BY artist;

WITH newest AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE convertedManaCost = 0
)
SELECT newest.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
JOIN newest ON cards.frameVersion = newest.frameVersion
GROUP BY newest.frameVersion;

WITH card_printings AS (
  SELECT c.frameVersion, s.releaseDate
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
),
latest_frame AS (
  SELECT frameVersion
  FROM card_printings
  WHERE frameVersion IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY releaseDate DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  lf.frameVersion AS latest_frame_year,
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN cp.frameVersion = lf.frameVersion THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
    / COUNT(*),
    2
  ) AS percent_of_printings
FROM card_printings AS cp
CROSS JOIN latest_frame AS lf;

WITH commander_legal AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uuid
  FROM legalities
  WHERE format = 'commander'
    AND status = 'Legal'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN commander_legal AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.manaCost = '{0}';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE keywords IS NOT NULL
  AND keywords LIKE '%Flying%'
  AND keywords LIKE '%Cycling%';

WITH abyssal_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code, s.name, s.releaseDate
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Abyssal Horror'
),
first_printing AS (
  SELECT code, name
  FROM abyssal_sets
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MIN(releaseDate) FROM abyssal_sets)
  ORDER BY code
  LIMIT 1
),
latest_set AS (
  SELECT code, name
  FROM sets
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM sets)
  ORDER BY code
  LIMIT 1
),
chosen_sets AS (
  SELECT code, name FROM first_printing
  UNION ALL
  SELECT code, name FROM latest_set
),
set_counts AS (
  SELECT
    s.code,
    s.name,
    COUNT(c.uuid) AS total_cards,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN c.manaCost IS NOT NULL
         AND c.manaCost <> ''
         AND c.convertedManaCost <= 3
        THEN 1 ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS qualifying_cards
  FROM chosen_sets s
  LEFT JOIN cards c ON c.setCode = s.code
  GROUP BY s.code, s.name
)
SELECT
  name AS set_name,
  ROUND(100.0 * qualifying_cards / NULLIF(total_cards, 0), 2) AS percentage
FROM set_counts
ORDER BY code;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId) AS different_cards
FROM cards
WHERE isPromo = 1
  AND promoTypes LIKE '%"release"%';

WITH abzan AS (
  SELECT
    c.uuid,
    c.name,
    c.number,
    CASE
      WHEN c.number GLOB '[0-9]*'
      THEN CAST(substr(c.number, 1, length(c.number) - length(ltrim(c.number, '0123456789'))) AS INTEGER)
    END AS collector_num
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE lower(c.watermark) = 'abzan'
),
highest AS (
  SELECT MAX(collector_num) AS max_num
  FROM abzan
)
SELECT
  a.name AS card_name,
  a.number AS collector_number,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foreign_data AS f WHERE f.uuid = a.uuid) AS foreign_language_printings
FROM abzan AS a
JOIN highest AS h ON a.collector_num = h.max_num
ORDER BY a.name, a.number;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards
WHERE borderColor = 'white'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND power <> '*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) < 3

SELECT c.name
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE s.name = 'Dark Ascension'
  AND c.keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
  AND c.convertedManaCost = (
    SELECT MAX(c2.convertedManaCost)
    FROM cards AS c2
    JOIN sets AS s2 ON s2.code = c2.setCode
    WHERE s2.name = 'Dark Ascension'
      AND c2.keywords LIKE '%Flash%'
  )
ORDER BY c.name;

SELECT
  s.name AS set_name,
  s.keyruneCode AS keyrune_code,
  COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS translated_name_language_count
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
  ON st.setCode = s.code
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.keyruneCode
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

WITH qualifying_sets AS (
  SELECT s.code
  FROM sets AS s
  WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2017-01-01'
    AND s.releaseDate < '2018-01-01'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM set_translations AS st
      WHERE st.setCode = s.code
        AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
        AND st.language <> 'English'
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_cards
FROM cards AS c
JOIN qualifying_sets AS q ON q.code = c.setCode;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT artist
  FROM cards
  WHERE lower(borderColor) = 'black'
    AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
    AND type LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND power GLOB '[0-9]*'
    AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 10
    AND artist IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
  SELECT artist, COUNT(*) AS card_count
  FROM eligible
  GROUP BY artist
)
SELECT artist, card_count
FROM counts
WHERE card_count = (SELECT MAX(card_count) FROM counts)
ORDER BY artist;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(c.scryfallOracleId, c.uuid)) AS card_count
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.hasContentWarning = 1
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%'
  AND c.availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%';

SELECT
  s.type AS expansion_type,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN st.language = 'Japanese'
      AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
    THEN s.id
  END) AS japanese_name_entry_sets
FROM sets AS s
LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
  ON st.setCode = s.code
GROUP BY s.type
ORDER BY s.type;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT artist) AS artist_count
FROM cards
WHERE artist IS NOT NULL
  AND artist <> ''
  AND lower(borderColor) = 'black'
  AND availability LIKE '%arena%'
  AND availability NOT LIKE '%mtgo%'
  AND power IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(power) <> ''
  AND power NOT GLOB '*[^0-9]*'
  AND CAST(power AS INTEGER) >= 5;

WITH ancestor_sets AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.code, s.releaseDate
  FROM cards c
  JOIN sets s ON c.setCode = s.code
  WHERE c.name = 'Ancestor''s Chosen'
),
latest_sets AS (
  SELECT code
  FROM ancestor_sets
  WHERE releaseDate = (SELECT MAX(releaseDate) FROM ancestor_sets)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM cards c
JOIN latest_sets ls ON c.setCode = ls.code
WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND CAST(c.power AS REAL) > CAST(c.toughness AS REAL);

SELECT COUNT(*) AS ruling_count
FROM rulings AS r
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = r.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Fireball';

WITH card_rulings AS (
  SELECT c.name, c.scryfallOracleId, COUNT(DISTINCT r.id) AS ruling_count
  FROM cards AS c
  LEFT JOIN rulings AS r ON r.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.originalType = 'Creature - Elf'
  GROUP BY c.name, c.scryfallOracleId
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT name, ruling_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ruling_count DESC) AS rank_num
  FROM card_rulings
)
SELECT name, ruling_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rank_num = 1
ORDER BY name;

WITH card_colors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT uuid, colors AS color
  FROM cards
  WHERE id BETWEEN 1 AND 20
    AND colors IN ('W', 'B')
),
color_formats AS (
  SELECT cc.color, l.format
  FROM card_colors AS cc
  JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = cc.uuid
  WHERE l.status = 'Legal'
  GROUP BY cc.color, l.format
)
SELECT color, COUNT(format) AS legal_format_count
FROM color_formats
GROUP BY color
ORDER BY color;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT frameVersion
  FROM cards
  WHERE artist = 'John Avon'
    AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
    AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
    AND frameVersion IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(frameVersion) AS frameVersion
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT e.frameVersion, COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM eligible AS e
JOIN latest AS l ON e.frameVersion = l.frameVersion
GROUP BY e.frameVersion;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist LIKE '%Erica Yang%'
  AND l.format = 'pauper'
  AND l.status = 'Legal'
  AND c.availability LIKE '%paper%'
  AND s.isOnlineOnly = 0;

SELECT name, cardKingdomFoilId, cardKingdomId
FROM cards
WHERE type LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND cardKingdomFoilId IS NOT NULL
  AND cardKingdomId IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY CAST(cardKingdomFoilId AS INTEGER), name COLLATE NOCASE, CAST(cardKingdomId AS INTEGER)
LIMIT 3;

WITH guilds(guild) AS (
  VALUES ('azorius'), ('boros'), ('dimir'), ('golgari'), ('gruul'),
         ('izzet'), ('orzhov'), ('rakdos'), ('selesnya'), ('simic')
),
counts AS (
  SELECT g.guild, COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS card_count
  FROM guilds AS g
  JOIN cards AS c ON lower(c.watermark) = g.guild
  JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
   AND lower(fd.language) <> 'english'
  GROUP BY g.guild
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT guild, card_count, MAX(card_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM counts
)
SELECT guild, card_count
FROM ranked
WHERE card_count = max_count
ORDER BY guild;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT scryfallOracleId) AS card_count
FROM cards
WHERE frameVersion >= '2015'
  AND text IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(text) <> '';

SELECT s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
WHERE c.name = 'Tarmogoyf'
  AND c.isReprint = 1
  AND CAST(substr(s.releaseDate, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) >= 10
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT c.uuid, c.setCode, c.number
  FROM cards AS c
  WHERE c.name = 'Counterspell'
),
localized AS (
  SELECT
    t.setCode,
    t.number,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(fd.language) = 'french' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_french,
    SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(fd.language) = 'italian' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_italian
  FROM target AS t
  JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = t.uuid
  GROUP BY t.setCode, t.number
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM localized
WHERE has_french > 0
  AND has_italian > 0;

WITH target_type AS (
  SELECT type
  FROM sets
  WHERE name = 'From the Vault: Lore'
)
SELECT s.name, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
JOIN target_type AS t ON s.type = t.type
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM set_translations AS st
  WHERE st.setCode = s.code
)
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.name;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT s.name AS set_name, s.releaseDate, c.frameVersion
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN sets AS s ON s.code = c.setCode
  WHERE c.name = 'Aven Mindcensor'
),
newest_frame AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(frameVersion AS INTEGER)) AS frame_version
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT DISTINCT c.set_name, c.releaseDate
FROM candidates AS c
JOIN newest_frame AS n
  ON CAST(c.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = n.frame_version
WHERE c.releaseDate = (
  SELECT MAX(c2.releaseDate)
  FROM candidates AS c2
  WHERE CAST(c2.frameVersion AS INTEGER) = n.frame_version
)
ORDER BY c.releaseDate, c.set_name

SELECT s.code, s.releaseDate
FROM sets AS s
WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2020-01-01'
  AND s.releaseDate < '2021-01-01'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations AS st
    WHERE st.setCode = s.code
      AND lower(st.language) = 'spanish'
  )
ORDER BY s.releaseDate, s.code;

SELECT SUM(convertedManaCost) AS total_converted_mana_cost
FROM cards
WHERE artist = 'Rob Alexander'
  AND originalReleaseDate >= '2013-01-01'
  AND originalReleaseDate < '2014-01-01'
  AND originalReleaseDate IS NOT NULL;

WITH set_language_counts AS (
  SELECT s.code, COUNT(DISTINCT st.language) AS language_count
  FROM sets AS s
  LEFT JOIN set_translations AS st
    ON st.setCode = s.code
   AND st.translation IS NOT NULL
   AND TRIM(st.translation) <> ''
  WHERE s.releaseDate >= '2016-01-01'
    AND s.releaseDate < '2017-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.code
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(language_count), 2) AS average_translated_languages
FROM set_language_counts;

WITH japanese_boros AS (
  SELECT
    fd.name AS japanese_name,
    c.type AS english_type,
    c.uuid
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN foreign_data AS fd
    ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.watermark = 'boros'
    AND fd.language = 'Japanese'
),
card_groups AS (
  SELECT
    japanese_name,
    english_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT uuid) AS printing_count
  FROM japanese_boros
  GROUP BY japanese_name, english_type
),
ruling_totals AS (
  SELECT
    jb.japanese_name,
    jb.english_type,
    COUNT(r.id) AS ruling_total
  FROM japanese_boros AS jb
  LEFT JOIN rulings AS r
    ON r.uuid = jb.uuid
  GROUP BY jb.japanese_name, jb.english_type
)
SELECT
  cg.japanese_name,
  cg.english_type,
  COALESCE(rt.ruling_total, 0) AS ruling_total
FROM card_groups AS cg
LEFT JOIN ruling_totals AS rt
  ON rt.japanese_name = cg.japanese_name
 AND rt.english_type = cg.english_type
ORDER BY cg.japanese_name, cg.english_type;

WITH set_languages AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT language
    FROM set_translations
    WHERE language IS NOT NULL
),
counts AS (
    SELECT sl.language, COUNT(DISTINCT fd.uuid) AS printings
    FROM set_languages AS sl
    LEFT JOIN foreign_data AS fd
        ON fd.language = sl.language
       AND fd.flavorText IS NOT NULL
       AND TRIM(fd.flavorText) <> ''
    GROUP BY sl.language
)
SELECT language, printings
FROM counts
WHERE printings = (SELECT MIN(printings) FROM counts)
ORDER BY language;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.name) AS count
FROM cards c
WHERE c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
  AND CAST(c.power AS INTEGER) >= 10
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM set_translations st
    JOIN sets s ON s.code = st.setCode
    WHERE st.language = 'French'
      AND instr(',' || c.printings || ',', ',' || s.code || ',') > 0
  );

WITH banned AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid, c.convertedManaCost
  FROM cards c
  JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.edhrecRank BETWEEN 1 AND 1000
    AND c.types LIKE '%Creature%'
    AND l.status = 'Banned'
    AND c.convertedManaCost IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(convertedManaCost), 1) AS average_mana_value
FROM banned;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_printings
FROM cards
WHERE power IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(power) <> ''
  AND TRIM(power) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) > 3
  AND CAST(power AS REAL) <= 10;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN sets AS s ON c.setCode = s.code
WHERE substr(c.originalReleaseDate, 1, 4) = '2014'
  AND s.mtgoCode IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(s.mtgoCode) <> '';

SELECT fd.language, COUNT(*) AS printings
FROM foreign_data AS fd
JOIN cards AS c ON c.uuid = fd.uuid
WHERE fd.language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Arabic', 'Hebrew', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit', 'Phyrexian')
GROUP BY fd.language
HAVING COUNT(*) = (
  SELECT MIN(printing_count)
  FROM (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS printing_count
    FROM foreign_data AS f
    JOIN cards AS c2 ON c2.uuid = f.uuid
    WHERE f.language NOT IN ('Ancient Greek', 'Arabic', 'Hebrew', 'Latin', 'Sanskrit', 'Phyrexian')
    GROUP BY f.language
  )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.uuid) AS count
FROM cards c
JOIN sets s ON s.code = c.setCode
JOIN foreign_data f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE s.name = 'Coldsnap'
  AND f.language = 'Italian'
  AND f.text IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT fd.language) AS foreign_language_count
FROM cards AS c
JOIN foreign_data AS fd ON fd.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.name = 'Swamp'
  AND fd.language IS NOT NULL
  AND lower(fd.language) <> 'english';

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.uuid
  FROM cards AS c
  JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f.uuid = c.uuid
  WHERE c.colors = '["B"]'
    AND c.types LIKE '%Artifact%'
    AND f.language IS NOT NULL
    AND f.flavorText IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(f.flavorText) <> ''
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
FROM eligible;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(u.Reputation), 0) AS combined_reputation
FROM users AS u
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%United Kingdom%'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM posts AS p
      WHERE p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS average_age
FROM comments AS c
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = c.UserId
WHERE c.Text LIKE '%http://%'

WITH organizer AS (
  SELECT UserId, Date AS organizer_date
  FROM badges
  WHERE Name = 'Organizer'
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT o.UserId, o.organizer_date
  FROM organizer o
  JOIN users u ON u.Id = o.UserId
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS user_count
FROM eligible e
WHERE (
  SELECT COUNT(*)
  FROM badges b
  WHERE b.UserId = e.UserId
    AND b.Date < e.organizer_date
) >= 5;

WITH first_posts AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId, MIN(CreaionDate) AS first_post_date
  FROM posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS users_count
FROM first_posts fp
JOIN users u ON u.Id = fp.OwnerUserId
WHERE fp.first_post_date >= '2010-01-01'
  AND fp.first_post_date < '2011-01-01'
  AND TRIM(u.Location) = 'India';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(u.Reputation)) AS average_reputation
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Score < 20
  AND p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'

WITH posts_2012 AS (
  SELECT Id, Score, LastEditorUserId
  FROM posts
  WHERE CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
    AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
),
germany_editors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT u.Id, u.Reputation
  FROM posts_2012 p
  JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId
  WHERE u.Location LIKE '%Germany%'
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Location LIKE '%Germany%' THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END), 0) AS germany_last_editor_posts_total_score,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN u.Id IS NULL OR u.Location NOT LIKE '%Germany%' THEN p.Score ELSE 0 END), 0) AS all_other_posts_total_score,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM germany_editors) AS germany_based_last_editors_count,
  COALESCE((SELECT SUM(Reputation) FROM germany_editors), 0) AS germany_editors_combined_reputation
FROM posts_2012 p
LEFT JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.LastEditorUserId

SELECT SUM(DISTINCT u.Reputation) AS combined_reputation
FROM posts AS p
JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
WHERE p.Tags LIKE '%<r>%'
  AND p.LasActivityDate >= '2014-08-27'
  AND p.LasActivityDate < '2014-08-28';

SELECT SUM(linking.Score) AS total_score
FROM postLinks AS pl
JOIN posts AS target ON target.Id = pl.RelatedPostId
JOIN posts AS linking ON linking.Id = pl.PostId
WHERE target.Title = 'A Probability distribution value exceeding 1 is OK?'
  AND linking.PostTypeId = 1
  AND linking.Tags LIKE '%<r>%';

WITH badge_totals AS (
    SELECT
        u.Id,
        u.DisplayName,
        COUNT(b.Id) AS badge_total
    FROM users AS u
    JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
    WHERE u.Location = 'Germany'
    GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
),
ranked_totals AS (
    SELECT
        badge_total,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY badge_total DESC) AS total_rank
    FROM badge_totals
)
SELECT
    bt.DisplayName,
    bt.badge_total
FROM badge_totals AS bt
JOIN ranked_totals AS rt ON rt.badge_total = bt.badge_total
WHERE rt.total_rank = 2
ORDER BY bt.DisplayName;

WITH california_users AS (
  SELECT Id, DisplayName, Views, Reputation
  FROM users
  WHERE UPPER(COALESCE(Location, '')) LIKE '%CA%'
     OR UPPER(COALESCE(Location, '')) LIKE '%CALIFORNIA%'
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    Id,
    DisplayName,
    Views,
    Reputation,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY Views DESC) AS view_rank
  FROM california_users
)
SELECT
  Id AS user_id,
  DisplayName AS display_name,
  Views AS profile_view_count,
  Reputation AS reputation
FROM ranked
WHERE view_rank = 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.Id) AS user_count
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Location LIKE '%India%'
  AND b.Name = 'Yearling'
  AND b.Date < '2014-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.DisplayName) AS distinct_display_names
FROM users AS u
JOIN badges AS b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE b.Name = 'Supporter'
  AND u.Age BETWEEN 19 AND 65;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT Id, Title
  FROM posts
  WHERE Title LIKE '%principal component scores%'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT c.Id, c.Title, COUNT(DISTINCT pl.Id) AS related_post_count
  FROM candidates AS c
  LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl
    ON pl.PostId = c.Id
  GROUP BY c.Id, c.Title
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         MAX(related_post_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM counts
)
SELECT Title, related_post_count
FROM ranked
WHERE related_post_count = max_count
ORDER BY Title;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(p.OwnerUserId, p.OwnerDisplayName)) AS user_count
FROM votes AS v
JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = v.PostId
WHERE v.BountyAmount >= 30
  AND v.CreationDate >= '2010-01-01'
  AND v.CreationDate < '2011-01-01'
  AND (p.OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL OR p.OwnerDisplayName IS NOT NULL);

WITH prolific_users AS (
  SELECT OwnerUserId AS user_id
  FROM posts
  WHERE OwnerUserId IS NOT NULL
    AND CreaionDate >= '2012-01-01'
    AND CreaionDate < '2013-01-01'
  GROUP BY OwnerUserId
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 10
),
upvote_counts AS (
  SELECT UserId AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS up_votes
  FROM votes
  WHERE VoteTypeId = 2
    AND UserId IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY UserId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(uc.up_votes, 0)), 2) AS avg_up_votes_cast,
       ROUND(AVG(u.Age), 2) AS avg_age
FROM prolific_users p
JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN upvote_counts uc ON uc.user_id = p.user_id;

WITH RECURSIVE months(month_start) AS (
  SELECT '2010-01-01'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
  FROM months
  WHERE month_start < '2010-12-01'
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.AnswerCount <= 2 THEN pl.PostId END) AS linked_posts
  FROM months AS m
  LEFT JOIN postLinks AS pl
    ON pl.CreationDate >= m.month_start
   AND pl.CreationDate < date(m.month_start, '+1 month')
  LEFT JOIN posts AS p
    ON p.Id = pl.PostId
  GROUP BY m.month_start
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(linked_posts), 2) AS average_monthly_posts
FROM monthly;

WITH eligible_posts AS (
  SELECT p.OwnerUserId
  FROM posts AS p
  WHERE p.CreaionDate >= '2010-01-01'
    AND p.CreaionDate < '2011-01-01'
    AND p.Score > 5
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN u.Reputation < 1000 OR u.Reputation IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS percentage_not_high_reputation
FROM eligible_posts AS ep
LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = ep.OwnerUserId
LIMIT 1;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT Id
  FROM posts
  WHERE Title = 'Why square the difference instead of taking the absolute value in standard deviation?'
),
edit_events AS (
  SELECT ph.UserId, ph.UserDisplayName
  FROM postHistory AS ph
  JOIN target AS t ON t.Id = ph.PostId
  WHERE ph.Comment IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(ph.Comment) <> ''
),
editor_counts AS (
  SELECT
    e.UserId,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(u.DisplayName, ''), NULLIF(e.UserDisplayName, ''), '(unknown)') AS DisplayName,
    COUNT(*) AS edit_comment_count
  FROM edit_events AS e
  LEFT JOIN users AS u ON u.Id = e.UserId
  GROUP BY e.UserId, DisplayName
)
SELECT DisplayName, edit_comment_count
FROM editor_counts
ORDER BY edit_comment_count DESC, DisplayName;

WITH customer_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        CustomerID,
        SUM(Amount) AS total_consumption
    FROM transactions_1k
    WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01'
      AND Date < '2013-01-01'
    GROUP BY CustomerID
)
SELECT
    c.Segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customer_consumption AS cc
JOIN customers AS c
  ON c.CustomerID = cc.CustomerID
WHERE cc.total_consumption < 30000
GROUP BY c.Segment;

SELECT c.Segment AS client_segment, COUNT(DISTINCT ym.CustomerID) AS customers_consumed_fuel_2013
FROM customers AS c
JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
WHERE ym.Date >= '2013-01' AND ym.Date < '2014-01'
  AND ym.Consumption > 0
GROUP BY c.Segment
ORDER BY c.Segment;

WITH high_value_fuel AS (
  SELECT datetime(t.Date || ' ' || t.Time) AS transaction_datetime
  FROM transactions_1k AS t
  JOIN gasstations AS g
    ON g.GasStationID = t.GasStationID
  WHERE g.Country = 'CZE'
    AND t.Price > 1000
)
SELECT CAST(
  (julianday(MAX(transaction_datetime)) - julianday(MIN(transaction_datetime))) * 24 * 60
  AS INTEGER
) AS elapsed_whole_minutes
FROM high_value_fuel;

SELECT c.Currency, ROUND(AVG(q.quarter_amount), 2) AS avg_quarter_fuel_consumption
FROM (
  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Amount) AS quarter_amount
  FROM transactions_1k
  WHERE Date >= '2013-04-01' AND Date < '2013-07-01'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
) AS q
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = q.CustomerID
WHERE c.Currency IN ('EUR', 'CZK')
GROUP BY c.Currency
ORDER BY c.Currency;

WITH annual_customer AS (
  SELECT CustomerID, SUM(Consumption) AS consumption_2012
  FROM yearmonth
  WHERE Date >= '2012-01-01' AND Date < '2013-01-01'
  GROUP BY CustomerID
),
currency_avg AS (
  SELECT c.Currency, AVG(a.consumption_2012) AS avg_consumption
  FROM annual_customer AS a
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = a.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency IN ('CZK', 'EUR')
  GROUP BY c.Currency
)
SELECT ROUND(
  MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'CZK' THEN avg_consumption END) -
  MAX(CASE WHEN Currency = 'EUR' THEN avg_consumption END)
) AS difference
FROM currency_avg;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM (
  SELECT t.CustomerID
  FROM transactions_1k AS t
  JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
    AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
    AND t.Date >= '2013-01-01'
    AND t.Date < '2014-01-01'
  GROUP BY t.CustomerID
  HAVING SUM(t.Amount) > 1000000
) AS qualifying_customers;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.CustomerID) AS sme_gas_customers
FROM transactions_1k AS t
JOIN customers AS c ON c.CustomerID = t.CustomerID
JOIN products AS p ON p.ProductID = t.ProductID
WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND LOWER(p.Description) LIKE '%gasoline%'
  AND t.Date >= '2013-02-01'
  AND t.Date < '2013-03-01';

WITH home_slot3 AS (
    SELECT home_player_3 AS player_api_id
    FROM Match
    WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM home_slot3 h
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = h.player_api_id
WHERE p.height > 180;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    p.player_api_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(pa.defensive_work_rate)) = 'high' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_high
  FROM Player p
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE p.birthday >= '1991-01-01'
    AND pa.defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.player_api_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ever_high) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_rated_high
FROM eligible;

WITH ranked_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    defensive_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
),
current_non_medium AS (
  SELECT player_api_id
  FROM ranked_attributes
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND LOWER(TRIM(defensive_work_rate)) <> 'medium'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM Player AS p
JOIN current_non_medium AS c
  ON c.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.height IS NOT NULL;

WITH risky_teams AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT team_api_id
  FROM Team_Attributes
  WHERE chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Risky'
),
dated_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    ta.team_api_id,
    ta.chanceCreationPassing,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY ta.team_api_id
      ORDER BY ta.date DESC, ta.id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
  JOIN risky_teams AS rt
    ON rt.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
  WHERE ta.date <= '2014-09-19'
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT
    t.team_short_name,
    da.team_api_id,
    da.chanceCreationPassing
  FROM dated_attributes AS da
  JOIN Team AS t
    ON t.team_api_id = da.team_api_id
  WHERE da.rn = 1
)
SELECT
  team_short_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) AS club_count,
  ROUND(AVG(chanceCreationPassing), 1) AS average_chance_creation_passing_risk
FROM eligible
GROUP BY team_short_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT team_api_id) > 1
ORDER BY average_chance_creation_passing_risk DESC, team_short_name ASC;

WITH ranked_attributes AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    defensive_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE defensive_work_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(defensive_work_rate) <> ''
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT p.height
  FROM Player AS p
  JOIN ranked_attributes AS a
    ON a.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
  WHERE a.rn = 1
    AND LOWER(TRIM(a.defensive_work_rate)) = 'medium'
    AND p.birthday >= '1990-01-01'
    AND p.birthday < '1996-01-01'
    AND p.height IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM cohort;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(p.weight), 1) AS average_weight
FROM Player AS p
JOIN Player_Attributes AS pa ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE LOWER(pa.preferred_foot) = 'left';

WITH lineup AS (
    SELECT m.id AS match_id, m.season, p.player_api_id
    FROM Match AS m
    JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
        m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
        m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
        m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
        m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
    )
    WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
)
SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.match_id) AS matches_played
FROM Player AS p
JOIN lineup AS l ON l.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name LIKE 'Adam%' AND p.weight > 170
GROUP BY p.player_api_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY p.player_name;

WITH qualifying_matches AS (
  SELECT
    m.home_team_api_id AS team_api_id,
    m.id AS match_id
  FROM Match AS m
  WHERE m.home_team_goal - m.away_team_goal >= 3
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Team_Attributes AS ta
      WHERE ta.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
        AND ta.date = (
          SELECT MAX(ta2.date)
          FROM Team_Attributes AS ta2
          WHERE ta2.team_api_id = m.home_team_api_id
            AND ta2.date <= m.date
        )
        AND ta.date <= m.date
        AND ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Fast'
    )
),
club_counts AS (
  SELECT team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS home_wins
  FROM qualifying_matches
  GROUP BY team_api_id
)
SELECT
  t.team_long_name AS club_name,
  t.team_short_name AS short_name,
  c.home_wins
FROM club_counts AS c
JOIN Team AS t
  ON t.team_api_id = c.team_api_id
ORDER BY c.home_wins DESC, t.team_long_name, t.id;

WITH season_players AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.season, lineup.player_api_id
    FROM Match AS m
    JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id
    JOIN Country AS c ON c.id = l.country_id
    JOIN Player AS lineup
      ON lineup.player_api_id IN (
          m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4,
          m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8,
          m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
          m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
          m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8,
          m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
      )
    WHERE c.name = 'Italy'
      AND m.season IN ('2008/2009', '2015/2016')
)
SELECT sp.season,
       COUNT(*) AS player_count,
       ROUND(AVG(p.height), 2) AS average_height_cm
FROM season_players AS sp
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_api_id = sp.player_api_id
GROUP BY sp.season
ORDER BY sp.season;

WITH ranked_ratings AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    volleys,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM Player AS p
JOIN ranked_ratings AS r
  ON r.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
 AND r.rn = 1
WHERE p.height > 180
  AND r.volleys > 70;

WITH player_goal_totals AS (
  SELECT home_player_3 AS player_id, SUM(home_team_goal) AS total_home_goals
  FROM Match
  WHERE home_player_3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY home_player_3
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(total_home_goals), 2) AS average_total_home_goals
FROM player_goal_totals;

WITH match_players AS (
    SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
),
country_counts AS (
    SELECT c.name AS country_name, COUNT(*) AS player_match_appearances
    FROM match_players mp
    JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = mp.player_id
    JOIN Country c ON c.id = mp.country_id
    WHERE p.weight <= 160
    GROUP BY c.id, c.name
)
SELECT country_name, player_match_appearances
FROM country_counts
WHERE player_match_appearances = (
    SELECT MIN(player_match_appearances) FROM country_counts
)
ORDER BY country_name;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    player_api_id,
    preferred_foot,
    attacking_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
  WHERE date <= '2015-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS player_count
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
  AND LOWER(preferred_foot) = 'left'
  AND LOWER(attacking_work_rate) IN ('low', 'medium');

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT
    preferred_foot,
    attacking_work_rate,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY player_api_id
      ORDER BY date DESC, id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM Player_Attributes
),
eligible AS (
  SELECT attacking_work_rate
  FROM ranked
  WHERE rn = 1
    AND preferred_foot = 'left'
    AND attacking_work_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(attacking_work_rate) <> ''
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(attacking_work_rate) = 'low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  1
) AS percentage
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT player_api_id) AS player_count
FROM Player_Attributes
WHERE date >= '2007-02-22'
  AND date < '2007-08-31'
  AND jumping >= 80;

WITH club AS (
  SELECT team_api_id
  FROM Team
  WHERE team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
),
final_match AS (
  SELECT MAX(m.date) AS match_date
  FROM Match AS m
  WHERE m.season = '2012/2013'
    AND (
      m.home_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM club)
      OR m.away_team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM club)
    )
)
SELECT a.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS a
WHERE a.team_api_id IN (SELECT team_api_id FROM club)
  AND a.date <= (SELECT match_date FROM final_match)
ORDER BY a.date DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH latest_per_player AS (
  SELECT pa.player_api_id, MAX(pa.date) AS rating_date
  FROM Player_Attributes pa
  WHERE pa.date <= '2013-07-12'
  GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
),
ratings AS (
  SELECT pa.player_api_id, pa.overall_rating
  FROM latest_per_player l
  JOIN Player_Attributes pa
    ON pa.player_api_id = l.player_api_id
   AND pa.date = l.rating_date
  WHERE pa.defensive_work_rate IN ('low', 'medium', 'high')
),
average_rating AS (
  SELECT AVG(overall_rating) AS avg_rating
  FROM ratings
),
donovan AS (
  SELECT r.overall_rating
  FROM ratings r
  JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id = r.player_api_id
  WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan'
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * (d.overall_rating - a.avg_rating) / a.avg_rating,
  2
) AS percentage_higher
FROM donovan d
CROSS JOIN average_rating a;

WITH qualifying_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  WHERE l.status = 'D'
)
SELECT
  d.A2 AS district,
  ROUND((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12, 2) AS unemployment_rate_pct_change
FROM district AS d
JOIN qualifying_districts AS q ON q.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A12 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY d.A2;

WITH first_month AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', MIN(date)) AS month
  FROM account
),
opening_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.district_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN first_month AS f
    ON strftime('%Y-%m', a.date) = f.month
),
populations AS (
  SELECT d.A2 AS district_name, d.A4 AS inhabitants
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN opening_districts AS od
    ON od.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT district_name, inhabitants
FROM populations
WHERE inhabitants = (SELECT MAX(inhabitants) FROM populations)
ORDER BY district_name;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM trans AS t
JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '');

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT d.A3 AS region, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
  FROM loan AS l
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  WHERE date(l.date) <= date('1995-12-31')
    AND date(l.date, '+' || l.duration || ' months', '-1 day') >= date('1995-12-31')
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT region, total_amount,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount DESC) AS rank
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT region, total_amount
FROM ranked
WHERE rank = 1
ORDER BY region;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS count
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN district dist ON dist.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE dist.A3 = 'north Bohemia'
  AND a.date <= '1995-12-31'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM trans t
    WHERE t.account_id = a.account_id
      AND t.bank = 'AB'
  );

WITH eligible_clients AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.district_id
    FROM client AS c
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
      ON owner_disp.client_id = c.client_id
     AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    WHERE c.district_id IN (
        SELECT district_id
        FROM district
        WHERE A3 = 'central Bohemia'
    )
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM card AS cd
          JOIN disp AS any_disp
            ON any_disp.disp_id = cd.disp_id
          WHERE any_disp.account_id = owner_disp.account_id
      )
),
eligible_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM eligible_clients
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_district_salary
FROM eligible_districts AS ed
JOIN district AS d
  ON d.district_id = ed.district_id;

WITH older_owned_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN disp AS d
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
   AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN client AS c
    ON c.client_id = d.client_id
  WHERE c.birth_date < '1950-01-01'
),
loan_counts AS (
  SELECT o.account_id, COUNT(l.loan_id) AS loans
  FROM older_owned_accounts AS o
  LEFT JOIN loan AS l
    ON l.account_id = o.account_id
  GROUP BY o.account_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(loans), 2) AS average_loans_per_account
FROM loan_counts;

WITH cohort_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.account_id
  FROM client AS c
  JOIN disp AS d ON d.client_id = c.client_id
  WHERE c.gender = 'M'
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1974 AND 1976
),
qualifying_payments AS (
  SELECT t.k_symbol
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN cohort_accounts AS ca ON ca.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.amount > 4000
)
SELECT
  COUNT(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN 1 END) AS household_payments,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN k_symbol IS NOT NULL AND k_symbol <> 'SIPO' THEN 1 END) AS other_purpose_payments
FROM qualifying_payments;

WITH borrowing_accounts AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opening_date,
        SUM(l.amount) AS total_borrowed
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN loan AS l
        ON l.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN district AS branch_d
        ON branch_d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE branch_d.A2 = 'Prachatice'
    GROUP BY a.account_id, a.date
),
account_owners AS (
    SELECT
        d.account_id,
        c.district_id AS home_district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY d.account_id
            ORDER BY d.client_id
        ) AS owner_choice
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
),
counterparties AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT t.account) AS outside_counterparty_count
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(t.bank) <> ''
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
households AS (
    SELECT
        b.account_id,
        b.opening_date,
        b.total_borrowed,
        COALESCE(cp.outside_counterparty_count, 0) AS outside_counterparty_count,
        home.A2 AS home_district,
        home.A8 AS home_district_population
    FROM borrowing_accounts AS b
    JOIN account_owners AS o
        ON o.account_id = b.account_id
       AND o.owner_choice = 1
    JOIN district AS home
        ON home.district_id = o.home_district_id
    LEFT JOIN counterparties AS cp
        ON cp.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    opening_date,
    total_borrowed,
    outside_counterparty_count,
    home_district,
    home_district_population,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY home_district_population DESC) AS population_rank
FROM households
ORDER BY home_district_population DESC, account_id ASC;

WITH eligible_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  JOIN disp AS dp
    ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
   AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN card AS c
    ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
   AND c.type = 'gold'
  WHERE d.A4 >= 250000
),
pair_totals AS (
  SELECT
    t.bank AS recipient_bank_code,
    t.account AS recipient_counter_account_number,
    COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
    SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount_paid
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN eligible_accounts AS e
    ON e.account_id = t.account_id
  WHERE t.date >= '1998-01-01'
    AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
    AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
  GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_amount_paid DESC) AS total_rank
  FROM pair_totals
)
SELECT
  recipient_bank_code,
  recipient_counter_account_number,
  outgoing_payment_count,
  total_amount_paid
FROM ranked
WHERE total_rank = 1
ORDER BY recipient_bank_code, recipient_counter_account_number;

WITH outgoing_with_purpose AS (
    SELECT t.amount, t.k_symbol
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE d.A2 = 'Pisek'
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.k_symbol IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN k_symbol = 'SIPO' THEN amount ELSE 0 END)
    / SUM(amount),
    2
) AS percentage
FROM outgoing_with_purpose;

WITH qualifying_clients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cl.client_id, cl.district_id, d.A3 AS region
  FROM client cl
  JOIN disp dp
    ON dp.client_id = cl.client_id
   AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
  WHERE cl.gender = 'F'
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM card cd
      WHERE cd.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    )
    AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan ln
      WHERE ln.account_id = dp.account_id
    )
),
eligible_districts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT region, district_id
  FROM qualifying_clients
),
region_stats AS (
  SELECT ed.region,
         ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS average_salary,
         ROUND(AVG(d.A12), 2) AS average_unemployment_1996
  FROM eligible_districts ed
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ed.district_id
  GROUP BY ed.region
),
ranked_districts AS (
  SELECT ed.region,
         d.A2 AS district_name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY ed.region
           ORDER BY d.A4 DESC, d.A2 ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM eligible_districts ed
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = ed.district_id
)
SELECT rs.region,
       rs.average_salary,
       rs.average_unemployment_1996,
       rd.district_name AS most_populous_district
FROM region_stats rs
JOIN ranked_districts rd
  ON rd.region = rs.region
 AND rd.rn = 1
ORDER BY rs.region;

WITH district_card_holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         LOWER(c.type) AS card_type,
         cl.district_id,
         d.A4 AS inhabitants
  FROM card AS c
  JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.disp_id = c.disp_id
  JOIN client AS cl ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = cl.district_id
  WHERE LOWER(c.type) IN ('gold', 'classic', 'junior')
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT card_type,
         district_id,
         inhabitants,
         MIN(inhabitants) OVER (PARTITION BY card_type) AS fewest_inhabitants
  FROM district_card_holders
)
SELECT card_type, district_id, inhabitants
FROM ranked
WHERE inhabitants = fewest_inhabitants
ORDER BY CASE card_type
           WHEN 'gold' THEN 1
           WHEN 'classic' THEN 2
           WHEN 'junior' THEN 3
         END,
         district_id;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.amount,
        a.district_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            ORDER BY l.amount DESC, l.loan_id ASC
        ) AS loan_rank
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
top_districts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT district_id
    FROM ranked_loans
    WHERE loan_rank <= 10
),
district_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A4 AS inhabitants,
        d.A11 AS average_salary
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN top_districts AS td ON td.district_id = d.district_id
)
SELECT
    district_id AS most_populous_district_id,
    inhabitants,
    ROUND(
        (SELECT AVG(average_salary) FROM district_metrics),
        2
    ) AS average_salary_across_top_loan_districts
FROM district_metrics
ORDER BY inhabitants DESC, district_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH withdrawal_by_district AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        SUM(t.amount) AS total_withdrawn
    FROM trans AS t
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
standing_order_by_account AS (
    SELECT account_id, SUM(amount) AS standing_order_debit
    FROM "order"
    GROUP BY account_id
),
standing_order_by_district AS (
    SELECT
        a.district_id,
        AVG(COALESCE(so.standing_order_debit, 0.0)) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM account AS a
    LEFT JOIN standing_order_by_account AS so ON so.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.district_id
),
qualifying AS (
    SELECT
        d.district_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        d.A4 AS population,
        w.total_withdrawn,
        CAST(w.total_withdrawn AS REAL) / d.A4 AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
        s.avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
    FROM district AS d
    JOIN withdrawal_by_district AS w ON w.district_id = d.district_id
    JOIN standing_order_by_district AS s ON s.district_id = d.district_id
    WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
)
SELECT
    district_name,
    region,
    population,
    total_withdrawn,
    ROUND(withdrawals_per_inhabitant, 2) AS withdrawals_per_inhabitant,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY withdrawals_per_inhabitant DESC) AS withdrawal_per_inhabitant_rank,
    ROUND(avg_standing_order_debit_per_account, 2) AS avg_standing_order_debit_per_account
FROM qualifying
ORDER BY withdrawal_per_inhabitant_rank, district_name;

WITH target_accounts AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, client_id
  FROM disp
  WHERE client_id = 3541
),
transaction_stats AS (
  SELECT
    account_id,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'VYDAJ' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_expense
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
region_district_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    district_id,
    A3,
    A2,
    A4,
    RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY A3 ORDER BY A4 DESC) AS population_rank,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      PARTITION BY A3
      ORDER BY A4 DESC, district_id
    ) AS populous_choice
  FROM district
),
region_client_counts AS (
  SELECT d.A3, COUNT(*) AS home_district_client_count
  FROM client c
  JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
region_top_district AS (
  SELECT A3, A2, A4
  FROM region_district_ranks
  WHERE populous_choice = 1
)
SELECT
  a.account_id,
  a.date AS account_opened_date,
  a.frequency,
  ad.A2 AS account_district_name,
  ad.A3 AS region,
  CASE WHEN ad.district_id = hc.district_id THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
    AS is_client_home_district,
  ad.A11 AS district_average_salary,
  COALESCE(l.status, 'none') AS loan_repayment_status,
  COALESCE(l.amount, 0) AS loan_amount,
  COALESCE(ts.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
  COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) AS total_income,
  COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS total_expense,
  COALESCE(ts.total_income, 0) - COALESCE(ts.total_expense, 0) AS net_balance,
  COALESCE(rcc.home_district_client_count, 0)
    AS region_home_district_client_count,
  rt.A2 AS most_populous_district_name,
  rt.A4 AS most_populous_district_inhabitants,
  rdr.population_rank AS account_district_population_rank_in_region
FROM target_accounts ta
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ta.account_id
JOIN client hc ON hc.client_id = ta.client_id
JOIN district ad ON ad.district_id = a.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN transaction_stats ts ON ts.account_id = a.account_id
LEFT JOIN region_client_counts rcc ON rcc.A3 = ad.A3
JOIN region_district_ranks rdr ON rdr.district_id = ad.district_id
JOIN region_top_district rt ON rt.A3 = ad.A3
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, a.account_id ASC;

WITH account_lending AS (
  SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.district_id,
    a.date,
    COALESCE(SUM(l.amount), 0) AS amount_lent
  FROM account AS a
  LEFT JOIN loan AS l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
  GROUP BY a.account_id, a.district_id, a.date
),
district_year AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y', al.date) AS opening_year,
    al.district_id,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened,
    SUM(al.amount_lent) AS amount_lent
  FROM account_lending AS al
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = al.district_id
  WHERE d.A3 = 'Central Bohemia'
    AND al.date >= '1996-01-01'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y', al.date), al.district_id
)
SELECT
  opening_year,
  SUM(accounts_opened) AS accounts_opened,
  SUM(amount_lent) AS total_amount_lent,
  ROUND(AVG(1.0 * amount_lent / accounts_opened), 2)
    AS avg_district_amount_lent_per_account
FROM district_year
GROUP BY opening_year
ORDER BY opening_year;

WITH eligible AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.date AS approval_date,
        l.amount AS approved_amount,
        d.A2 AS district
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE l.duration = 24
      AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        t.balance AS approval_day_end_balance,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY e.loan_id
            ORDER BY date(t.date) DESC, t.trans_id DESC
        ) AS transaction_rank
    FROM eligible AS e
    JOIN trans AS t
      ON t.account_id = e.account_id
     AND date(t.date) <= date(e.approval_date)
)
SELECT
    district,
    approved_amount,
    approval_date,
    approval_day_end_balance
FROM ranked
WHERE transaction_rank = 1
ORDER BY approved_amount DESC, date(approval_date) ASC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
  d.A2 AS branch_name,
  COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count
FROM district AS d
JOIN account AS a ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'north Moravia'
  AND t.date <= '1998-10-14'
  AND (t.k_symbol IS NULL OR TRIM(t.k_symbol) = '')
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY transaction_count DESC, branch_name ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
    CASE
        WHEN t.k_symbol = 'UROK' THEN t.amount
        WHEN t.k_symbol LIKE 'SANKC%UROK%' THEN -t.amount
        ELSE 0
    END
), 0) AS net_interest_czk
FROM trans AS t
JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE a.account_id = (
    SELECT a2.account_id
    FROM account AS a2
    JOIN disp AS d ON d.account_id = a2.account_id
    WHERE d.client_id = 2823
)
  AND t.date >= '1998-01-01'
  AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
  AND (t.k_symbol = 'UROK' OR t.k_symbol LIKE 'SANKC%UROK%');

WITH female_loans AS (
    SELECT
        l.loan_id,
        l.account_id,
        l.amount,
        l.duration,
        l.payments,
        l.status,
        c.client_id,
        c.birth_date,
        a.district_id AS branch_district_id
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN disp AS dp
        ON dp.account_id = l.account_id
       AND dp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    WHERE c.gender = 'F'
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT
        *,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY amount DESC) AS amount_rank
    FROM female_loans
),
account_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_deposits
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
region_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        d.A3 AS region,
        COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loans_in_region,
        ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
    FROM loan AS l
    JOIN account AS a
        ON a.account_id = l.account_id
    JOIN district AS d
        ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    GROUP BY d.A3
)
SELECT
    r.client_id,
    r.amount AS loan_amount,
    r.duration AS duration_months,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration, 2) AS total_payments,
    ROUND(r.payments * r.duration - r.amount, 2) AS interest_paid,
    r.status AS loan_status,
    d.A2 AS branch_district,
    d.A3 AS region,
    COALESCE(am.transaction_count, 0) AS transaction_count,
    ROUND(COALESCE(am.total_deposits, 0), 2) AS total_deposits,
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(am.total_deposits, 0) > 2 * r.amount THEN 'High Income'
        WHEN COALESCE(am.total_deposits, 0) > r.amount THEN 'Medium Income'
        ELSE 'Low Income'
    END AS income_category,
    rm.loans_in_region,
    rm.avg_district_salary AS region_average_salary,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
        - CAST(strftime('%Y', r.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
        - CASE
            WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', r.birth_date)
            THEN 1 ELSE 0
          END AS completed_age
FROM ranked AS r
JOIN district AS d
    ON d.district_id = r.branch_district_id
LEFT JOIN account_metrics AS am
    ON am.account_id = r.account_id
JOIN region_metrics AS rm
    ON rm.region = d.A3
WHERE r.amount_rank <= 3
ORDER BY r.amount DESC, r.loan_id;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    d.district_id,
    d.A11 AS salary,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
  FROM district AS d
  JOIN account AS a
    ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  WHERE d.A4 >= 100000
    AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'
    AND a.date >= '1997-01-01'
    AND a.date < '1998-01-01'
  GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A11
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(accounts_opened), 0) AS total_monthly_statement_accounts_opened,
  COUNT(*) AS qualifying_districts,
  ROUND(AVG(salary), 2) AS average_salary
FROM qualifying;

WITH gold_accounts AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id, a.district_id
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN disp AS dp ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
    JOIN card AS c ON c.disp_id = dp.disp_id
    WHERE LOWER(c.type) = 'gold'
),
transaction_totals AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_received,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS total_withdrawn,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN t.account IS NOT NULL
             AND TRIM(CAST(t.account AS TEXT)) <> ''
            THEN t.account
        END) AS external_counterparties
    FROM trans AS t
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
loan_counts AS (
    SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) AS number_of_loans
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
),
account_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        ga.account_id,
        d.A2 AS district_name,
        d.A3 AS region,
        COALESCE(tt.total_received, 0) AS total_received,
        COALESCE(tt.total_withdrawn, 0) AS total_withdrawn,
        COALESCE(lc.number_of_loans, 0) AS number_of_loans,
        COALESCE(tt.external_counterparties, 0) AS external_counterparties
    FROM gold_accounts AS ga
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = ga.district_id
    LEFT JOIN transaction_totals AS tt ON tt.account_id = ga.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_counts AS lc ON lc.account_id = ga.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    district_name,
    region,
    total_received,
    total_withdrawn,
    number_of_loans,
    external_counterparties,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY external_counterparties DESC) AS counterparty_rank
FROM account_metrics
ORDER BY counterparty_rank, account_id;

WITH
account_base AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        a.date AS opened_date,
        c.gender,
        c.birth_date
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS br
        ON br.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN disp AS owner_disp
        ON owner_disp.account_id = a.account_id
       AND owner_disp.type = 'OWNER'
    JOIN client AS c
        ON c.client_id = owner_disp.client_id
    WHERE br.A2 = 'Tabor'
      AND a.date <= '1996-12-31'
),
card_counts AS (
    SELECT
        d.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS card_count
    FROM disp AS d
    JOIN card AS ca
        ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
    WHERE ca.issued <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY d.account_id
),
loan_stats AS (
    SELECT
        l.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.status = 'B' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_default,
        MAX(CASE WHEN l.status IN ('C', 'D') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_repaying
    FROM loan AS l
    WHERE l.date <= '1996-12-31'
    GROUP BY l.account_id
),
activity AS (
    SELECT
        t.account_id,
        COUNT(*) AS transaction_count_1997,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'credit' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_in_1997,
        SUM(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('debit', 'cash withdrawal') THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END) AS money_out_1997,
        MAX(t.balance) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM trans AS t
    WHERE t.date >= '1997-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1998-01-01'
    GROUP BY t.account_id
),
profile AS (
    SELECT
        b.account_id,
        b.opened_date,
        b.gender,
        CAST(strftime('%Y', '1996-12-31') AS INTEGER)
          - CAST(strftime('%Y', b.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
          - CASE
                WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '1996-12-31') < strftime('%m-%d', b.birth_date) THEN 1
                ELSE 0
            END AS age_years,
        COALESCE(cc.card_count, 0) AS card_count,
        COALESCE(ls.loan_count, 0) AS loan_count,
        CASE
            WHEN ls.loan_count IS NULL THEN 'no loan'
            WHEN ls.has_default = 1 THEN 'defaulted'
            WHEN ls.has_repaying = 1 THEN 'repaying'
            ELSE 'paid off'
        END AS loan_standing,
        COALESCE(ac.transaction_count_1997, 0) AS transaction_count_1997,
        COALESCE(ac.money_in_1997, 0) AS money_in_1997,
        COALESCE(ac.money_out_1997, 0) AS money_out_1997,
        COALESCE(ac.peak_balance_1997, 0) AS peak_balance_1997
    FROM account_base AS b
    LEFT JOIN card_counts AS cc
        ON cc.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN loan_stats AS ls
        ON ls.account_id = b.account_id
    LEFT JOIN activity AS ac
        ON ac.account_id = b.account_id
)
SELECT
    account_id,
    opened_date,
    gender,
    age_years,
    card_count,
    loan_count,
    loan_standing,
    transaction_count_1997,
    money_in_1997,
    money_out_1997,
    peak_balance_1997,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY peak_balance_1997 DESC) AS peak_balance_rank_1997
FROM profile
ORDER BY peak_balance_1997 DESC, account_id ASC;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         a.account_id,
         a.district_id,
         d.client_id
  FROM account AS a
  JOIN disp AS d
    ON d.account_id = a.account_id
   AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  JOIN card AS c
    ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
   AND c.type = 'classic'
),
client_counts AS (
  SELECT district_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) AS client_count
  FROM eligible
  GROUP BY district_id
),
payment_metrics AS (
  SELECT e.district_id,
         COUNT(DISTINCT printf('%s:%s', t.bank, t.account)) AS external_account_count,
         SUM(t.amount) AS total_outgoing_amount
  FROM eligible AS e
  JOIN trans AS t
    ON t.account_id = e.account_id
  WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
    AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
    AND t.account IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY e.district_id
)
SELECT d.A2 AS district_name,
       COALESCE(cc.client_count, 0) AS client_count,
       COALESCE(pm.external_account_count, 0) AS external_account_count,
       COALESCE(pm.total_outgoing_amount, 0) AS total_outgoing_amount
FROM district AS d
LEFT JOIN client_counts AS cc
  ON cc.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN payment_metrics AS pm
  ON pm.district_id = d.district_id
ORDER BY total_outgoing_amount DESC, district_name ASC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(x.A11), 2) AS average_salary
FROM (
