    SELECT DISTINCT branch.district_id, district.A11
    FROM client
    JOIN disp ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
    JOIN account ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
    JOIN district AS branch ON branch.district_id = account.district_id
    JOIN district ON district.district_id = branch.district_id
    WHERE client.gender = 'F'
      AND client.birth_date < '1930-01-01'
) AS x;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A13), 2) AS average_district_salary_czk
FROM client AS c
JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date < '1950-01-01';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(d.A11), 2) AS avg_district_salary
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount < 100000
  AND l.status = 'C';

WITH races_2017 AS (
  SELECT r.raceId
  FROM races r
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM races r2000
      WHERE r2000.year = 2000
        AND r2000.circuitId = r.circuitId
    )
),
stops_per_race AS (
  SELECT r.raceId, COUNT(p.stop) AS pit_stop_count
  FROM races_2017 r
  LEFT JOIN pitStops p ON p.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY r.raceId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(pit_stop_count), 2) AS average_pit_stops_per_race
FROM stops_per_race;

SELECT
  d.forename,
  d.surname,
  d.url AS wikipedia_page,
  d.dob AS date_of_birth,
  COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_times
FROM drivers AS d
LEFT JOIN qualifying AS q
  ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.nationality = 'German'
  AND d.dob >= '1971-01-01'
  AND d.dob < '1986-01-01'
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.url, d.dob
ORDER BY q3_times DESC, d.dob ASC;

WITH q1_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.driverRef,
    d.nationality,
    d.dob,
    q.q1,
    MAX(q.q1) OVER () AS slowest_q1
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 1995
    AND r.name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
    AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q1 <> '\N'
)
SELECT driverRef, nationality, dob, q1
FROM q1_times
WHERE q1 = slowest_q1;

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 1995
    AND name = 'Japanese Grand Prix'
),
times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q1
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN race AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE q.q1 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q1 <> '\N'
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(q1) AS q1
  FROM times
)
SELECT d.forename, d.surname, t.q1 AS q1_time
FROM times AS t
JOIN fastest AS f ON t.q1 = f.q1
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = t.driverId;

WITH di_grassi AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE forename = 'Lucas' AND surname = 'di Grassi'
),
race_positions AS (
  SELECT q.raceId, q.driverId, q.position
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE r.year = 2010
    AND q.position IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM race_positions AS lucas
JOIN di_grassi AS d ON d.driverId = lucas.driverId
JOIN race_positions AS other
  ON other.raceId = lucas.raceId
 AND lucas.position < other.position;

WITH q2_times AS (
  SELECT d.nationality,
         CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
         + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1, instr(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1), '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
         + CAST(substr(q.q2, length(q.q2) - 2) AS INTEGER) AS lap_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM q2_times
WHERE lap_ms = (SELECT MIN(lap_ms) FROM q2_times);

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(*) AS runners_up_count
FROM races AS ra
JOIN results AS re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = re.driverId
WHERE ra.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND re.position = 2
GROUP BY d.forename
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY runners_up_count DESC, d.forename ASC;

SELECT d.forename, d.surname, d.url,
       strftime('%H:%M:%S', r.time, '+' || (res.milliseconds / 1000) || ' seconds', '+4 hours')
         || '.' || printf('%03d', res.milliseconds % 1000) AS local_finish_time
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Azerbaijan Grand Prix'
  AND res.position = 1
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.driverRef, d.nationality, d.dob
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON q.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON q.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q3 IS NULL;

WITH q2_times AS (
  SELECT
    d.nationality,
    q.q2,
    CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, 1, INSTR(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(SUBSTR(q.q2, INSTR(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS seconds
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q2 <> ''
),
ranked_times AS (
  SELECT nationality, q2, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY seconds) AS time_rank
  FROM q2_times
)
SELECT DISTINCT nationality
FROM ranked_times
WHERE time_rank = 2;

WITH longest AS (
  SELECT MAX(milliseconds) AS max_ms
  FROM pitStops
)
SELECT
  c.name AS racetrack_name,
  c.location,
  c.country,
  r.year AS season_year,
  p.duration AS pit_stop_length
FROM pitStops AS p
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = p.raceId
JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
JOIN longest AS l ON p.milliseconds = l.max_ms
ORDER BY r.year, c.name;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT driverId
  FROM drivers
  WHERE dob >= '1981-01-01' AND dob < '1992-01-01'
),
q3_counts AS (
  SELECT c.driverId, COUNT(q.q3) AS q3_lap_times
  FROM cohort c
  LEFT JOIN qualifying q
    ON q.driverId = c.driverId
   AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.driverId
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(q3_lap_times), 2) AS average_q3_lap_times_per_driver
FROM q3_counts;

WITH shared_first_names AS (
    SELECT forename
    FROM drivers
    GROUP BY forename
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS qualifying_1_times_over_two_minutes
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE d.code IS NULL
  AND d.forename IN (SELECT forename FROM shared_first_names)
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
      CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
      + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) > 120;

SELECT d.driverRef AS reference_name,
       SUM(res.points) AS total_points
FROM drivers AS d
JOIN results AS res
  ON res.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE d.forename = 'Robert'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM lapTimes AS lt
    WHERE lt.driverId = res.driverId
      AND lt.raceId = res.raceId
  )
GROUP BY d.driverId, d.driverRef
ORDER BY d.driverRef;

WITH italian_q3 AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    q.q3,
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS time_ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'Italian'
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(q.q3) <> ''
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(time_ms) AS min_time
  FROM italian_q3
)
SELECT DISTINCT i.forename, i.surname, i.q3
FROM italian_q3 AS i
JOIN fastest AS f ON i.time_ms = f.min_time;

WITH british_q3 AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_full_name,
    r.name AS race_name,
    r.year AS race_year,
    q.q3 AS q3_time,
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60.0
      + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1) AS REAL) AS q3_seconds
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE d.nationality = 'British'
    AND CAST(strftime('%Y', d.dob) AS INTEGER) > 1980
    AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q3 <> ''
)
SELECT driver_full_name, race_name, race_year, q3_time
FROM british_q3
WHERE q3_seconds = (SELECT MIN(q3_seconds) FROM british_q3)
ORDER BY race_year, race_name, driver_full_name;

WITH driver_race_best AS (
  SELECT raceId, driverId, MIN(milliseconds) AS best_lap_ms
  FROM lapTimes
  WHERE milliseconds IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY raceId, driverId
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    raceId,
    driverId,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY raceId
      ORDER BY best_lap_ms
    ) AS lap_rank
  FROM driver_race_best
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId
WHERE r.lap_rank = 2
  AND d.dob >= '1976-01-01';

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
q3_times AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q3,
         CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
         + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
         + CAST(substr(q.q3, length(q.q3) - 2, 3) AS INTEGER) AS time_ms
  FROM qualifying q
  JOIN race r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT d.driverRef
FROM q3_times t
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = t.driverId
WHERE t.time_ms = (SELECT MIN(time_ms) FROM q3_times);

SELECT d.forename, COUNT(DISTINCT d.driverId) AS winning_drivers
FROM drivers d
JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
WHERE r.position = 1
  AND d.forename IN ('Peter', 'John')
GROUP BY d.forename
ORDER BY d.forename;

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT driverId,
         CAST(substr(q3, 1, instr(q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000 +
         CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000 +
         CAST(round(CAST(substr(q3, instr(q3, ':') + 4) AS REAL) * 1000) AS INTEGER) AS ms
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE q3 IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(q3) <> ''
    AND instr(q3, ':') > 0
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(ms) AS ms FROM parsed
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM parsed p
JOIN fastest f ON p.ms = f.ms
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = p.driverId;

WITH race_fastest AS (
  SELECT raceId, MIN(fastestLapTime) AS fastestLapTime
  FROM results
  WHERE fastestLapTime IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY raceId
),
credited_constructors AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.constructorId
  FROM results AS r
  JOIN race_fastest AS f
    ON f.raceId = r.raceId
   AND f.fastestLapTime = r.fastestLapTime
)
SELECT
  c.nationality,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
    WHEN cc.constructorId IS NOT NULL THEN c.constructorId
  END) AS constructors_with_fastest_lap
FROM constructors AS c
LEFT JOIN credited_constructors AS cc
  ON cc.constructorId = c.constructorId
GROUP BY c.nationality
ORDER BY c.nationality;

WITH eligible_races AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ds.raceId
  FROM driverStandings AS ds
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = ds.driverId
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId
  WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
    AND d.nationality = 'Australian'
    AND ds.position BETWEEN 1 AND 19
)
SELECT r.year AS season_year,
       COUNT(p.raceId) AS pit_stop_count
FROM races AS r
LEFT JOIN eligible_races AS er ON er.raceId = r.raceId
LEFT JOIN pitStops AS p ON p.raceId = er.raceId
WHERE r.year BETWEEN 2002 AND 2013
GROUP BY r.year
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.driverId) AS driver_count
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 1995
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q1 <> ''
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q1, 1, instr(q.q1, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60.0
    + CAST(substr(q.q1, instr(q.q1, ':') + 1) AS REAL)
  ) > 120.0;

WITH eligible_stops AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS driver_name,
    ps.duration AS pit_stop_time,
    ps.milliseconds,
    r.name AS race_name,
    c.name AS circuit_name,
    c.location AS circuit_location
  FROM pitStops AS ps
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = ps.raceId
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = ps.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2016
    AND strftime('%m', r.date) = '09'
    AND ps.milliseconds IS NOT NULL
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT MIN(milliseconds) AS fastest_ms
  FROM eligible_stops
)
SELECT
  e.driver_name,
  e.pit_stop_time,
  e.race_name,
  e.circuit_name,
  e.circuit_location
FROM eligible_stops AS e
JOIN fastest AS f ON e.milliseconds = f.fastest_ms
ORDER BY e.driver_name, e.race_name;

WITH winners AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob, d.nationality
  FROM drivers d
  JOIN results r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
  JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
  WHERE r.position = 1
    AND ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
),
oldest_winner AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM winners
  ORDER BY dob ASC, forename COLLATE NOCASE ASC, surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
first_win AS (
  SELECT ra.name, ra.date
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN oldest_winner ow ON ow.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE r.position = 1
    AND ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
  ORDER BY ra.date ASC, ra.name COLLATE NOCASE ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
starts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS race_starts
  FROM results r
  JOIN races ra ON ra.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN oldest_winner ow ON ow.driverId = r.driverId
  WHERE ra.year BETWEEN 1950 AND 2017
)
SELECT ow.forename || ' ' || ow.surname AS full_name,
       ow.nationality,
       fw.name AS first_race_won,
       fw.date AS first_win_date,
       s.race_starts
FROM oldest_winner ow
CROSS JOIN first_win fw
CROSS JOIN starts s;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.raceId) AS runnings_with_accident_retirement
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN status AS s ON s.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND s.status = 'Accident';

WITH q2_ranks AS (
  SELECT
    d.forename,
    d.surname,
    c.name AS constructor_name,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY
        (CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
         + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1) AS REAL)) ASC,
        res.grid ASC
    ) AS q2_rank
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  JOIN constructors AS c ON c.constructorId = q.constructorId
  JOIN results AS res
    ON res.raceId = q.raceId
   AND res.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q2 <> ''
)
SELECT forename, surname, constructor_name
FROM q2_ranks
WHERE q2_rank = 2;

WITH parsed AS (
  SELECT
    d.surname,
    r.name AS race_name,
    q.q2,
    CAST(substr(q.q2, 1, instr(q.q2, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
      + CAST(substr(q.q2, instr(q.q2, ':') + 4) AS INTEGER) AS ms
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
  WHERE r.year = 2017
    AND q.q2 IS NOT NULL
    AND q.q2 <> ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *, MIN(ms) OVER () AS best_ms
  FROM parsed
)
SELECT surname, race_name, q2
FROM ranked
WHERE ms = best_ms;

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
fastest AS (
  SELECT q.driverId, q.q3
  FROM qualifying AS q
  JOIN race AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
  WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, instr(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1), '.') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 1000
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER)
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT d.number
FROM fastest AS f
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = f.driverId;

WITH target_race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2017
      AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
),
parsed AS (
    SELECT q.driverId,
           q.q3,
           CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60000
           + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 1000
           + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS INTEGER) AS q3_ms
    FROM qualifying q
    JOIN target_race r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
    WHERE q.q3 IS NOT NULL
      AND q.q3 <> ''
),
fastest AS (
    SELECT MIN(q3_ms) AS q3_ms
    FROM parsed
)
SELECT d.code AS driver_code,
       p.q3 AS fastest_q3_time
FROM parsed p
JOIN fastest f ON p.q3_ms = f.q3_ms
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = p.driverId
ORDER BY d.code;

WITH race AS (
  SELECT raceId
  FROM races
  WHERE year = 2017 AND name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
)
SELECT DISTINCT d.nationality
FROM qualifying q
JOIN race r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE q.q3 = (
  SELECT MIN(q3)
  FROM qualifying
  WHERE raceId = r.raceId
    AND q3 IS NOT NULL
);

WITH chinese_gp AS (
  SELECT raceId, year, time
  FROM races
  WHERE name = 'Chinese Grand Prix'
    AND year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2009
    AND time IS NOT NULL
),
parsed AS (
  SELECT raceId, year, time,
         CAST(substr(time, 1, 2) AS INTEGER) * 3600 +
         CAST(substr(time, 4, 2) AS INTEGER) * 60 +
         CAST(substr(time, 7, 2) AS INTEGER) AS seconds
  FROM chinese_gp
),
chosen AS (
  SELECT raceId, year, time
  FROM parsed
  WHERE seconds = (SELECT MIN(seconds) FROM parsed)
  ORDER BY year DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c.year AS season_year,
       c.time AS scheduled_local_start_time,
       d.forename || ' ' || d.surname AS runner_up,
       r.time AS runner_up_time_gap
FROM chosen c
JOIN results r ON r.raceId = c.raceId AND r.positionOrder = 2
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = r.driverId;

SELECT DISTINCT d.code
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(q.q3) <> ''
ORDER BY d.code;

SELECT
  r.year AS race_year,
  d.forename AS winner_forename,
  d.surname AS winner_surname,
  res.time AS winner_finish_time
FROM races AS r
JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = res.driverId
WHERE r.name = 'Canadian Grand Prix'
  AND r.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2017
  AND time(r.time) <= '17:00:00'
  AND res.positionOrder = 1
ORDER BY r.year;

SELECT d.number AS permanent_career_number, d.surname
FROM qualifying q
JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q3 IS NOT NULL
  AND (
    CAST(substr(q.q3, 1, instr(q.q3, ':') - 1) AS INTEGER) * 60
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, ':') + 1, 2) AS INTEGER)
    + CAST(substr(q.q3, instr(q.q3, '.') + 1) AS REAL) / 1000.0
  ) < 98.0

WITH timed_races AS (
  SELECT
    c.circuitRef,
    r.time,
    MIN(r.time) OVER () AS earliest_time,
    MAX(r.time) OVER () AS latest_time
  FROM races AS r
  JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId
  WHERE r.time IS NOT NULL
),
extremes AS (
  SELECT circuitRef, time, earliest_time, latest_time
  FROM timed_races
  WHERE time = earliest_time OR time = latest_time
),
measures AS (
  SELECT MIN(earliest_time) AS earliest_time, MAX(latest_time) AS latest_time
  FROM timed_races
)
SELECT
  (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
   FROM (
     SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
     FROM extremes
     WHERE time = earliest_time
     ORDER BY circuitRef
   )) AS earliest_circuit_refs,
  (SELECT earliest_time FROM measures) AS earliest_start_time,
  (SELECT group_concat(circuitRef, ', ')
   FROM (
     SELECT DISTINCT circuitRef
     FROM extremes
     WHERE time = latest_time
     ORDER BY circuitRef
   )) AS latest_circuit_refs,
  (SELECT latest_time FROM measures) AS latest_start_time,
  CAST(strftime('%s', (SELECT latest_time FROM measures)) AS INTEGER)
    - CAST(strftime('%s', (SELECT earliest_time FROM measures)) AS INTEGER)
    AS gap_seconds
FROM measures;

WITH career_highs AS (
  SELECT d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob,
         MAX(CAST(r.fastestLapSpeed AS REAL)) AS career_high_speed
  FROM drivers AS d
  JOIN results AS r ON r.driverId = d.driverId
  WHERE d.dob >= '1980-01-01'
    AND d.dob < '1991-01-01'
    AND r.fastestLapSpeed IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(r.fastestLapSpeed) <> ''
  GROUP BY d.driverId, d.forename, d.surname, d.dob
)
SELECT forename, surname
FROM career_highs
ORDER BY career_high_speed DESC, dob ASC, surname COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT d.driverRef
FROM qualifying AS q
JOIN races AS r ON r.raceId = q.raceId
JOIN drivers AS d ON d.driverId = q.driverId
WHERE r.year = 2017
  AND r.name = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND q.q1 IS NOT NULL
  AND q.q2 IS NULL
ORDER BY q.q1 DESC, q.driverId ASC;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS withdrew_drivers
FROM results AS res
JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = res.raceId
JOIN status AS st ON st.statusId = res.statusId
WHERE ra.year = 1962
  AND ra.name = 'British Grand Prix'
  AND st.status = 'Withdrew';

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'Finished' OR s.status LIKE '+% lap%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage FROM races ra JOIN results r ON r.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN status s ON s.statusId = r.statusId WHERE ra.year = 1957 AND ra.name = 'British Grand Prix';

WITH fall_events AS (
  SELECT event_id, event_name
  FROM event
  WHERE event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND event_date < '2019-12-01'
),
event_counts AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    COUNT(a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
  FROM fall_events AS e
  LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
summary AS (
  SELECT
    (SELECT attendee_count
     FROM event_counts
     WHERE event_name = 'Women''s Soccer') AS womens_soccer_attendees,
    ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 1) AS fall_2019_average
  FROM event_counts
)
SELECT
  womens_soccer_attendees,
  fall_2019_average,
  CASE
    WHEN womens_soccer_attendees > fall_2019_average THEN 'more'
    WHEN womens_soccer_attendees < fall_2019_average THEN 'fewer'
    ELSE 'equal'
  END AS verdict
FROM summary;

WITH college_majors AS (
  SELECT major_id, major_name, department
  FROM major
  WHERE college = 'College of Humanities and Social Sciences'
),
department_summary AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    COUNT(*) AS offered_count,
    group_concat(major_name, ', ') AS majors_offered
  FROM college_majors
  GROUP BY department
),
held_by_major AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cm.department, cm.major_id, cm.major_name
  FROM college_majors cm
  JOIN member m ON m.link_to_major = cm.major_id
),
held_summary AS (
  SELECT
    department,
    group_concat(major_name, ', ') AS majors_held,
    COUNT(*) AS held_major_count
  FROM held_by_major
  GROUP BY department
)
SELECT
  ds.department AS department_name,
  ds.majors_offered,
  COALESCE(hs.majors_held, '') AS majors_held_by_members,
  ROUND(COALESCE(hs.held_major_count, 0) * 1.0 / ds.offered_count, 2) AS average_members_per_major_offered
FROM department_summary ds
LEFT JOIN held_summary hs ON hs.department = ds.department
ORDER BY ds.department;

WITH qualifying_budget_lines AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_budget
    FROM expense
    WHERE cost > 50
),
expenses_by_budget AS (
    SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_spent
    FROM expense
    GROUP BY link_to_budget
)
SELECT
    m.first_name,
    m.last_name,
    ROUND(SUM(b.amount - COALESCE(eb.total_spent, 0)), 2) AS total_remaining_dollars
FROM member AS m
JOIN expense AS e
    ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
   AND e.cost > 50
JOIN qualifying_budget_lines AS q
    ON q.link_to_budget = e.link_to_budget
JOIN budget AS b
    ON b.budget_id = q.link_to_budget
LEFT JOIN expenses_by_budget AS eb
    ON eb.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
ORDER BY total_remaining_dollars DESC, m.last_name ASC, m.first_name ASC;

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS total_dues_dollars
FROM income AS i
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_member = i.link_to_member
JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.event_name LIKE '%Football%'
  AND i.source = 'Dues';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS majors_without_enrolled_members
FROM major AS m
WHERE m.college = (

        SELECT link_to_major
        FROM member
        WHERE first_name = 'Tyler'
          AND last_name = 'Hewitt'
    )
)

);

WITH advertising_events AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
    FROM budget
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'advertising'
),
attendance_by_event AS (
    SELECT
        ae.link_to_event,
        COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS attendee_count
    FROM advertising_events AS ae
    LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
        ON a.link_to_event = ae.link_to_event
    GROUP BY ae.link_to_event
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(attendee_count), 2) AS average_attendees_per_advertising_event
FROM attendance_by_event;

SELECT e.event_name, e.location, COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Budget'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, e.location
ORDER BY e.event_date, e.event_name;

WITH major_attendance AS (
  SELECT
    m.link_to_major AS major_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS attendee_count
  FROM attendance a
  JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
  WHERE e.event_name = 'Football game'
  GROUP BY m.link_to_major
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    major_id,
    attendee_count,
    MAX(attendee_count) OVER () AS max_count
  FROM major_attendance
)
SELECT
  ma.major_name,
  r.attendee_count
FROM ranked r
JOIN major ma ON r.major_id = ma.major_id
WHERE r.attendee_count = r.max_count
ORDER BY ma.major_name ASC;

WITH over_budget_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT link_to_event
  FROM budget
  WHERE CAST(amount AS REAL) - CAST(spent AS REAL) < 0
),
descriptions AS (
  SELECT LOWER(expense_description) AS description
  FROM expense
  JOIN budget ON expense.link_to_budget = budget.budget_id
  WHERE budget.link_to_event IN (SELECT link_to_event FROM over_budget_events)
    AND expense_description IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT TRIM(value)) AS distinct_kind_count
FROM descriptions,
     json_each(
       '["' || REPLACE(
         REPLACE(REPLACE(description, ' & ', '","'), ', ', '","'),
         ' and ', '","'
       ) || '"]'
     )
WHERE TRIM(value) <> '';

WITH event_attendance AS (
  SELECT link_to_event, COUNT(DISTINCT link_to_member) AS attendee_count
  FROM attendance
  GROUP BY link_to_event
),
water_spend AS (
  SELECT b.link_to_event, SUM(x.cost) AS water_cost
  FROM budget AS b
  JOIN expense AS x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  WHERE lower(x.expense_description) LIKE '%water%'
  GROUP BY b.link_to_event
)
SELECT
  e.event_name,
  printf('%.2f', COALESCE(ws.water_cost, 0.0) / ea.attendee_count) AS water_spend_per_attendee
FROM event AS e
JOIN event_attendance AS ea ON ea.link_to_event = e.event_id
LEFT JOIN water_spend AS ws ON ws.link_to_event = e.event_id
ORDER BY e.event_name, e.event_id;

WITH vp AS (
  SELECT member_id
  FROM member
  WHERE position = 'Vice President'
),
latest AS (
  SELECT MAX(e.expense_date) AS expense_date
  FROM expense e
  JOIN vp ON e.link_to_member = vp.member_id
)
SELECT latest.expense_date, SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost
FROM expense e
JOIN vp ON e.link_to_member = vp.member_id
JOIN latest ON e.expense_date = latest.expense_date
GROUP BY latest.expense_date;

SELECT
  e.type AS event_category,
  COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS club_members_attended
FROM event AS e
LEFT JOIN attendance AS a
  ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.location = 'MU 215'
GROUP BY e.type
ORDER BY e.type;

WITH college_counts AS (
  SELECT ma.college, COUNT(DISTINCT ma.major_id) AS major_count
  FROM member AS me
  JOIN major AS ma ON ma.major_id = me.link_to_major
  GROUP BY ma.college
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    college,
    major_count,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY major_count DESC) AS ranking
  FROM college_counts
)
SELECT college, major_count
FROM ranked
WHERE ranking = 1
ORDER BY college;

WITH pizza_events AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.event_id
  FROM event e
  JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  WHERE e.event_date >= '2019-09-01'
    AND e.event_date < '2019-10-01'
    AND x.expense_description = 'Pizza'
)
SELECT SUM(b.amount) AS total_budgeted
FROM budget b
JOIN pizza_events p ON p.event_id = b.link_to_event;

WITH event_budget AS (
  SELECT
    e.event_id,
    e.event_name,
    SUM(COALESCE(b.amount, 0)) AS total_budget,
    SUM(COALESCE(b.spent, 0)) AS total_spending
  FROM event e
  LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE LOWER(e.status) = 'closed'
  GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
),
purchase_counts AS (
  SELECT
    eb.event_id,
    eb.event_name,
    COUNT(x.expense_id) AS purchase_count
  FROM event_budget eb
  LEFT JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = eb.event_id
  LEFT JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
  WHERE eb.total_spending <= eb.total_budget
  GROUP BY eb.event_id, eb.event_name
)
SELECT event_name
FROM purchase_counts
ORDER BY purchase_count DESC, event_id ASC
LIMIT 1;

WITH attendance_by_type AS (
  SELECT
    e.type AS event_type,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS member_count
  FROM event AS e
  JOIN attendance AS a
    ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
  WHERE date(e.event_date) >= date('2019-09-01')
    AND date(e.event_date) < date('2020-06-01')
  GROUP BY e.type
)
SELECT event_type, member_count
FROM attendance_by_type
WHERE member_count = (
  SELECT MAX(member_count)
  FROM attendance_by_type
)
ORDER BY event_type;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item, COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE LOWER(b.category) = 'food'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY record_count DESC, e.expense_description COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT
  e.expense_description AS item_name,
  b.category AS budget_category,
  SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost_usd
FROM expense AS e
JOIN budget AS b
  ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event AS v
  ON b.link_to_event = v.event_id
WHERE v.event_name = 'October Meeting'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(e.approved)) IN ('approved', 'yes', 'true', '1')
GROUP BY e.expense_description, b.category
ORDER BY b.category, e.expense_description;

SELECT e.expense_description AS item_name, COUNT(*) AS times_bought
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sacha' AND m.last_name = 'Harrison'
GROUP BY e.expense_description
ORDER BY e.expense_description;

WITH RECURSIVE split(member_id, rest, item) AS (
    SELECT link_to_member, expense_description || ',', ''
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'

    UNION ALL

    SELECT member_id,
           substr(rest, instr(rest, ',') + 1),
           TRIM(substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, ',') - 1))
    FROM split
    WHERE rest <> ''
),
kinds AS (
    SELECT member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT item) AS kind_count
    FROM split
    WHERE item <> ''
    GROUP BY member_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT member_id,
           kind_count,
           MAX(kind_count) OVER () AS max_kind_count
    FROM kinds
),
totals AS (
    SELECT link_to_member AS member_id, SUM(cost) AS spending
    FROM expense
    WHERE expense_date >= '2019-10-01'
      AND expense_date < '2019-12-01'
    GROUP BY link_to_member
)
SELECT m.first_name || ' ' || m.last_name AS full_name,
       r.kind_count AS different_item_kinds,
       t.spending AS total_spending_dollars
FROM ranked r
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = r.member_id
JOIN totals t ON t.member_id = r.member_id
WHERE r.kind_count = r.max_kind_count
ORDER BY full_name;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT major.major_id) AS distinct_major_count
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.department = 'Political Science';

WITH marvel_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN publisher AS pub ON pub.id = s.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE pub.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
),
dc_powers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.power_id
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN publisher AS pub ON pub.id = s.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE pub.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
),
marvel_with_unmatched_power AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.id, s.height_cm
    FROM superhero AS s
    JOIN publisher AS pub ON pub.id = s.publisher_id
    JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
    WHERE pub.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
      AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL
      AND hp.power_id IN (
          SELECT power_id FROM marvel_powers
          EXCEPT
          SELECT power_id FROM dc_powers
      )
)
SELECT AVG(height_cm) AS average_height_cm
FROM marvel_with_unmatched_power;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS power_count
FROM (
    SELECT hp.power_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    GROUP BY hp.power_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
       AND COUNT(*) = SUM(
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM hero_power AS strength_hp
               JOIN superpower AS strength_sp
                 ON strength_sp.id = strength_hp.power_id
               WHERE strength_hp.hero_id = hp.hero_id
                 AND strength_sp.power_name = 'Super Strength'
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
       )
) AS qualifying_powers;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 1) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment NOT IN ('Good', 'Bad')
   OR a.alignment IS NULL;

WITH abomination_intelligence AS (
  SELECT ha.attribute_value
  FROM superhero s
  JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
  JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
  WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination'
    AND a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (SELECT attribute_value FROM abomination_intelligence)
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT g.gender, h.id
  FROM superhero AS h
  JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
  JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = h.hair_colour_id
  JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = h.id
  WHERE LOWER(c.colour) = 'blue'
    AND LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
  GROUP BY h.id, g.gender
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) >= 10
)
SELECT requested_gender.gender, COUNT(eligible.id) AS superhero_count
FROM (SELECT 'Male' AS gender UNION ALL SELECT 'Female') AS requested_gender
LEFT JOIN eligible ON eligible.gender = requested_gender.gender
GROUP BY requested_gender.gender
ORDER BY requested_gender.gender;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(h.weight_kg AS REAL)), 0) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON ha.hero_id = h.id
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
    SELECT ha2.attribute_value
    FROM superhero AS hulk
    JOIN hero_attribute AS ha2 ON ha2.hero_id = hulk.id
    JOIN attribute AS a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
    WHERE hulk.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
      AND a2.attribute_name = 'Strength'
  )
  AND h.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT id, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY height_cm DESC) AS height_rank
  FROM superhero
  WHERE height_cm IS NOT NULL
),
tallest AS (
  SELECT id
  FROM ranked
  WHERE height_rank <= 10
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS different_superpowers
FROM tallest AS t
LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = t.id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS character_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
WHERE p.id = (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
)
AND s.race_id IS NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(p.power_count, 0)), 2) AS average_superpowers_per_hero
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = h.gender_id
JOIN race AS r ON r.id = h.race_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT hero_id, COUNT(*) AS power_count
    FROM hero_power
    GROUP BY hero_id
) AS p ON p.hero_id = h.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Male'
  AND r.race = 'God / Eternal';

WITH cryo AS (
  SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE LOWER(power_name) = 'cryokinesis'
),
holders AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
  FROM hero_power hp
  JOIN cryo c ON hp.power_id = c.id
),
relevant AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT shared.hero_id
  FROM holders h
  JOIN hero_power holder_powers ON holder_powers.hero_id = h.hero_id
  JOIN hero_power shared ON shared.power_id = holder_powers.power_id
),
counts AS (
  SELECT r.hero_id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM relevant r
  JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = r.hero_id
  GROUP BY r.hero_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(power_count), 1) AS average_superpowers
FROM counts;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.height_cm AS REAL)), 1) AS average_height_cm
FROM superhero AS a
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.race_id = a.race_id
WHERE a.superhero_name = 'A-Bomb'
  AND s.height_cm IS NOT NULL;

SELECT AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
WHERE s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND s.race_id IN (
    SELECT r.id
    FROM race AS r
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM superhero AS female_hero
      JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = female_hero.gender_id
      WHERE female_hero.race_id = r.id
        AND LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
    )
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS publisher_count
FROM publisher AS p
JOIN superhero AS s ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.height_cm > 200;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
LEFT JOIN publisher AS p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Good'
  AND (p.publisher_name IS NULL OR p.publisher_name <> 'DC Comics');

WITH blackwulf_publisher AS (
    SELECT publisher_id
    FROM superhero
    WHERE superhero_name = 'Blackwulf'
),
other_publisher_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT h.eye_colour_id
    FROM superhero h
    JOIN blackwulf_publisher bp
      ON h.publisher_id <> bp.publisher_id
    WHERE h.publisher_id IS NOT NULL
      AND h.eye_colour_id IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM superhero h
JOIN blackwulf_publisher bp
  ON h.publisher_id = bp.publisher_id
WHERE h.eye_colour_id IN (
    SELECT eye_colour_id
    FROM other_publisher_eye_colours
);

WITH target_publisher AS (
  SELECT publisher_id
  FROM superhero
  WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler'
),
race_counts AS (
  SELECT r.race, COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN race AS r ON r.id = s.race_id
  WHERE s.publisher_id IN (SELECT publisher_id FROM target_publisher)
    AND s.race_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY r.race
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT race, superhero_count,
         RANK() OVER (ORDER BY superhero_count DESC) AS race_rank
  FROM race_counts
)
SELECT race, superhero_count
FROM ranked
WHERE race_rank = 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(ha.attribute_value), 1) AS average_intelligence
FROM hero_attribute AS ha
JOIN attribute AS a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'intelligence'
  AND ha.attribute_value IS NOT NULL
  AND ha.hero_id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT hp.hero_id
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    JOIN superpower AS sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
    WHERE sp.power_name IN ('Super speed', 'Death touch')
  );

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT s.id, g.gender
  FROM superhero AS s
  JOIN gender AS g ON g.id = s.gender_id
  WHERE s.full_name IS NOT NULL
    AND LENGTH(TRIM(s.full_name)) > 0
    AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0
    AND LOWER(g.gender) IN ('male', 'female')
),
per_hero AS (
  SELECT e.id, e.gender, COUNT(hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM eligible AS e
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = e.id
  GROUP BY e.id, e.gender
)
SELECT gender, ROUND(AVG(power_count), 2) AS avg_superpowers_per_hero
FROM per_hero
GROUP BY gender
ORDER BY gender;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(s.height_cm), 2) AS avg_height_cm, ROUND(AVG(s.weight_kg), 2) AS avg_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN colour AS c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND c.colour = 'Green';

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL))) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
JOIN colour AS c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id
JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower AS p ON p.id = hp.power_id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Bad'
  AND LOWER(c.colour) = 'green'
  AND LOWER(p.power_name) = 'flight'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(h.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS h
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = h.publisher_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'
  AND h.weight_kg IS NOT NULL
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = h.id
  );

SELECT ROUND(AVG(CAST(s.weight_kg AS REAL)), 2) AS average_weight_kg
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN gender AS g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(g.gender) = 'female'
  AND LOWER(a.alignment) = 'good'
  AND s.weight_kg IS NOT NULL;

WITH lightest AS (
  SELECT MIN(weight_kg) AS weight_kg
  FROM superhero
  WHERE weight_kg IS NOT NULL
),
hero_counts AS (
  SELECT s.id, COUNT(DISTINCT hp.power_id) AS power_count
  FROM superhero AS s
  LEFT JOIN hero_power AS hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
  WHERE s.weight_kg = (SELECT weight_kg FROM lightest)
  GROUP BY s.id
)
SELECT MAX(power_count) AS max_power_count
FROM hero_counts;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN alignment AS a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE LOWER(a.alignment) = 'neutral'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> '';

WITH brown_eye_colours AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT eye.colour AS eye_colour
    FROM superhero AS brown_hero
    JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = brown_hero.hair_colour_id
    JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.id = brown_hero.eye_colour_id
    WHERE hair.colour = 'Brown'
)
SELECT bec.eye_colour,
       COUNT(*) AS hero_count
FROM brown_eye_colours AS bec
JOIN colour AS eye ON eye.colour = bec.eye_colour
JOIN superhero AS hero ON hero.eye_colour_id = eye.id
LEFT JOIN colour AS hair ON hair.id = hero.hair_colour_id
WHERE hair.colour IS NULL OR hair.colour <> 'Brown'
GROUP BY bec.eye_colour
ORDER BY hero_count DESC, bec.eye_colour ASC;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND s.full_name IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(s.full_name) <> ''
  AND INSTR(TRIM(s.full_name), ' ') > 0;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN s.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT s.id), 2) AS percentage
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN publisher AS p ON p.id = s.publisher_id
JOIN alignment AS a ON a.id = s.alignment_id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM hero_power AS hp
    WHERE hp.hero_id = s.id
  );

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM superhero s
   JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
   WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL AND c.colour = 'No Colour')
  -
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
   FROM superhero s
   JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
   WHERE s.weight_kg IS NULL AND LOWER(c.colour) = 'blue')
  AS count_difference;

WITH elevated AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE l.UA IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      (p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA > 8.0)
      OR (p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.5)
    )
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS males,
    SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS females
  FROM elevated
)
SELECT
  males,
  females,
  CAST(males AS REAL) / NULLIF(females, 0) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM counts;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE date(p.Birthday, '+56 years') < date('2026-10-09')
    AND date(l.Date) <= date('2026-10-09')
    AND l.PT >= 14
)
SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
  2
) AS female_percentage
FROM eligible;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.CRP LIKE '+%'
  AND (p.Description IS NULL OR TRIM(CAST(p.Description AS TEXT)) = '');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS distinct_female_patients
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND lower(trim(l.SC170)) IN ('negative', '0')
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  );

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = 'inpatient' THEN p.ID END)
  / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID), 0),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday >= '1930-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1941-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
  );

WITH max_rnp AS (
  SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL)) AS max_rnp_value
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(RNP) <> ''
), strongest_rnp_tests AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) = (SELECT max_rnp_value FROM max_rnp)
), max_bilirubin AS (
  SELECT MAX("T-BIL") AS max_tbil
  FROM strongest_rnp_tests
  WHERE "T-BIL" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  l."T-BIL" AS total_bilirubin,
  l.Date AS lab_test_date,
  l.ID AS patient_id,
  p.SEX AS sex,
  p.Birthday AS birthday
FROM strongest_rnp_tests AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" = (SELECT max_tbil FROM max_bilirubin)
ORDER BY l.Date, l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Birthday > '1960-01-01'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
      AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  )
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
      AND LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) <> 'negative'
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 10
  );

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission LIKE '%-%'
    AND l.SSA IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(LOWER(l.SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', '0')
),
rnp_values AS (
  SELECT l.ID, CAST(TRIM(l.RNP) AS REAL) AS rnp_titer
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
)
SELECT ID, rnp_titer
FROM rnp_values
WHERE rnp_titer = (SELECT MAX(rnp_titer) FROM rnp_values)
ORDER BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE TRIM(p.Diagnosis) = 'MCTD'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  )
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 5
  );

WITH never_examined AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Examination AS e
      WHERE e.ID = p.ID
    )
),
lab_dates AS (
  SELECT ID, COUNT(DISTINCT Date) AS date_count
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
)
SELECT n.SEX,
       ROUND(AVG(COALESCE(l.date_count, 0)), 2) AS average_laboratory_test_dates
FROM never_examined AS n
LEFT JOIN lab_dates AS l ON l.ID = n.ID
GROUP BY n.SEX
ORDER BY n.SEX;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    l.Date AS test_date,
    l.DNA AS anti_dna_level
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('f', 'female')
    AND LOWER(p.Admission) LIKE '%inpatient%'
    AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    patient_id,
    test_date,
    anti_dna_level,
    RANK() OVER (
      PARTITION BY patient_id
      ORDER BY CAST(anti_dna_level AS REAL) DESC
    ) AS level_rank
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT patient_id, test_date, anti_dna_level
FROM ranked
WHERE level_rank = 1
ORDER BY patient_id;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(l.TP - 8.5), 3) AS average_deviation
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND (e.Diagnosis = 'SLE' OR e.Diagnosis LIKE 'SLE,%' OR e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%')
  AND l.TP > 8.5;

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

WITH proteinuria_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM("U-PRO") IN ('3', '4', '300', '1000')
)
SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age_years
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN proteinuria_patients AS x ON x.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL;

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 32
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS women,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS men
FROM qualifying_patients q
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = q.ID;

WITH thrombosis_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Thrombosis = 1
),
qualifying AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age_years
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  JOIN thrombosis_patients AS t ON t.ID = l.ID
  WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
    AND p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
    AND l.Date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT MIN(age_years) AS youngest_age
FROM qualifying;

WITH PsoriaticPatients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%psoriatic arthritis%'
),
TestCounts AS (
  SELECT p.ID, COUNT(l.Date) AS laboratory_test_count
  FROM PsoriaticPatients p
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
  GROUP BY p.ID
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(laboratory_test_count), 0) AS total_laboratory_tests,
  SUM(CASE WHEN laboratory_test_count = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_laboratory_tests
FROM TestCounts;

WITH sle_patients AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
),
symptom_items AS (
  SELECT TRIM(
           substr(
             e.Symptoms || ',',
             n.n,
             instr(substr(e.Symptoms || ',', n.n), ',') - 1
           )
         ) AS symptom
  FROM Examination e
  JOIN sle_patients p ON p.ID = e.ID
  JOIN (
    SELECT 1 AS n UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL
    SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL
    SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9 UNION ALL SELECT 10
  ) n
    ON n.n = 1
    OR n.n <= length(e.Symptoms) - length(replace(e.Symptoms, ',', '')) + 1
  WHERE e.Thrombosis = 1
    AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
),
cleaned AS (
  SELECT symptom
  FROM symptom_items
  WHERE symptom <> ''
)
SELECT symptom
FROM cleaned
GROUP BY symptom
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, symptom COLLATE NOCASE ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT ROUND(
  100.0 * SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN LOWER(COALESCE("Diagnosis", '')) LIKE '%sle%'
        OR LOWER(COALESCE("Diagnosis", '')) LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
      THEN 1 ELSE 0
    END
  ) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
  2
) AS percentage
FROM "Examination"
WHERE "Thrombosis" = 1;

SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.Date >= '1994-01-01'
  AND l.Date < '1995-01-01'
  AND l.GOT < 60
  AND p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT p.ID AS patient_id,
       CAST((julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 AS INTEGER) AS age_years
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.LDH > 600
      AND l.LDH < 800
      AND (
          CASE
              WHEN TRIM(l."U-PRO") GLOB '[0-9]*'
                   AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
              THEN CAST(TRIM(l."U-PRO") AS REAL)
              WHEN LOWER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) LIKE 'at least %'
                   AND SUBSTR(TRIM(l."U-PRO"), 10) GLOB '[0-9]*'
                   AND SUBSTR(TRIM(l."U-PRO"), 10) NOT GLOB '*[^0-9.]*'
              THEN CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM(l."U-PRO"), 10) AS REAL)
              ELSE NULL
          END
      ) >= 300
)
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN p.ID END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN p.ID END) AS difference
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

WITH sex_totals AS (
  SELECT SEX, COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS total_patients
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX IN ('M', 'F')
  GROUP BY SEX
),
out_of_range AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX IN ('M', 'F')
    AND l.CRE >= 1.5
)
SELECT
  s.SEX,
  COUNT(DISTINCT o.ID) AS patients_with_creatinine_out_of_range,
  s.total_patients,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT o.ID) / s.total_patients, 1) AS percentage
FROM sex_totals AS s
LEFT JOIN out_of_range AS o ON o.SEX = s.SEX
GROUP BY s.SEX, s.total_patients
ORDER BY CASE s.SEX WHEN 'M' THEN 1 WHEN 'F' THEN 2 END;

WITH maxima AS (
  SELECT p.Admission, MAX(l."T-CHO") AS max_tcho
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission IN ('+', '-') AND l."T-CHO" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY p.Admission
)
SELECT p.Admission, l."T-CHO" AS "T-CHO", p.ID AS patient_id
FROM maxima AS m
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.Admission = m.Admission
JOIN Laboratory AS l
  ON l.ID = p.ID
 AND l."T-CHO" = m.max_tcho
ORDER BY CASE p.Admission WHEN '+' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, p.ID;

WITH first_1991 AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE "First Date" >= '1991-01-01'
    AND "First Date" < '1992-01-01'
),
recorded AS (
  SELECT l.ID, CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) AS rnp_level
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN first_1991 AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
),
highest AS (
  SELECT MAX(rnp_level) AS max_level
  FROM recorded
)
SELECT recorded.ID AS patient_id,
       recorded.rnp_level AS anti_RNP_level
FROM recorded
JOIN highest ON recorded.rnp_level = highest.max_level
ORDER BY recorded.ID;

WITH latest_lab_date AS (
  SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
),
latest_scl70 AS (
  SELECT ID, SC170,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date DESC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SC170 IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT p.ID
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN latest_lab_date AS d ON d.ID = p.ID
JOIN latest_scl70 AS s ON s.ID = p.ID AND s.rn = 1
WHERE d.latest_date > '1997-01-01'
  AND (LOWER(TRIM(s.SC170)) = 'negative' OR TRIM(s.SC170) = '0')
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH anti_ssa_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE SSA IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(TRIM(SSA)) NOT IN ('negative', 'zero')
),
proteinuria_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE "U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(TRIM("U-PRO")) NOT IN ('negative', 'none')
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM anti_ssa_patients a
JOIN proteinuria_patients p USING (ID);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(l.DNA AS REAL) < 8;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.Admission <> '-'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.ALP >= 300
  );

SELECT MAX(CAST(RNP AS REAL)) AS highest_anti_RNP
FROM Laboratory
WHERE CRE < 1.5
  AND RNP IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(RNP) <> '';

WITH severe_anemia AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE HGB < 7.0
)
SELECT CASE p.SEX
         WHEN 'F' THEN 'female'
         WHEN 'M' THEN 'male'
       END AS sex,
       COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN severe_anemia AS s ON s.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY CASE p.SEX WHEN 'F' THEN 1 WHEN 'M' THEN 2 END;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT ID, Date, RNP
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE GOT >= 60
    AND RNP IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    ID AS patient_id,
    Date AS test_date,
    RNP AS anti_ribonuclear_protein_reading,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY CAST(RNP AS REAL) DESC) AS reading_rank
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT patient_id, test_date, anti_ribonuclear_protein_reading
FROM ranked
WHERE reading_rank = 1;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.ID
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
    AND (
      EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
          AND l.FG IS NOT NULL
          AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450)
      )
      OR EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM Laboratory AS l
        WHERE l.ID = p.ID
          AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
          AND (
            CAST(l."U-PRO" AS REAL) >= 300
            OR l."U-PRO" LIKE '>=%'
            OR l."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4')
          )
      )
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM eligible;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT ID, Admission
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%thrombosis%'
     OR Diagnosis LIKE '%autoimmune%'
)
SELECT
  CASE Admission
    WHEN '+' THEN 'admitted to the hospital'
    WHEN '-' THEN 'followed at the outpatient clinic'
  END AS patient_group,
  COUNT(*) AS normal_range_measurements
FROM cohort
JOIN Laboratory USING (ID)
WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
  AND LDH < 500
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY CASE Admission WHEN '+' THEN 1 WHEN '-' THEN 2 END;

WITH unrecorded_sex AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(SEX) = ''
)
SELECT
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l.ID IS NOT NULL THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_lab,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN l."T-BIL" >= 2.0 THEN p.ID END) AS patients_with_elevated_bilirubin
FROM unrecorded_sex AS p
LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND p.Birthday >= '1945-01-01'
  AND p.Birthday < '1990-01-01'
  AND p.Admission LIKE '+%'
  AND e."ANA Pattern" = 'P';

WITH outpatient_anemic AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT p.ID
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.Admission)) = 'outpatient'
    AND CAST(l.HGB AS REAL) < 10
),
patient_maxima AS (
  SELECT l.ID, MAX(CAST(l.RNP AS REAL)) AS max_rnp
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN outpatient_anemic AS oa ON oa.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.RNP IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l.RNP) <> ''
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY l.ID
),
highest AS (
  SELECT MAX(max_rnp) AS value
  FROM patient_maxima
)
SELECT p.ID AS patient_id, p.SEX AS sex, pm.max_rnp AS highest_anti_RNP
FROM patient_maxima AS pm
JOIN highest AS h ON pm.max_rnp = h.value
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = pm.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH RankedLabs AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    Date,
    GOT,
    RNP,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY Date ASC) AS rn
  FROM Laboratory
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) AS patient_count
FROM RankedLabs
WHERE rn = 1
  AND GOT < 60
  AND CAST(RNP AS REAL) > 10;

WITH ranked_proteinuria AS (
    SELECT
        l.ID,
        l.Date,
        l."U-PRO" AS proteinuria_level,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY l.ID
            ORDER BY l.Date DESC
        ) AS rn
    FROM Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
),
thrombosis_cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ID
    FROM Examination
    WHERE Thrombosis = 1
)
SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_identifier,
    p.SEX AS sex,
    rp.Date AS most_recent_proteinuria_test_date,
    rp.proteinuria_level
FROM ranked_proteinuria AS rp
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = rp.ID
JOIN thrombosis_cohort AS tc ON tc.ID = p.ID
WHERE rp.rn = 1
ORDER BY p.ID;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE CAST(RNP AS REAL) >= 16
  GROUP BY ID
),
patient_gpt AS (
  SELECT l.ID, MAX(l.GPT) AS highest_normal_gpt
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN eligible AS e ON e.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.GPT < 60
  GROUP BY l.ID
  HAVING COUNT(l.GPT) > 0
)
SELECT p.Birthday
FROM patient_gpt AS g
JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = g.ID
ORDER BY g.highest_normal_gpt DESC, g.ID ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(p.SEX) IN ('f', 'female')
  AND e.Thrombosis = 1
  AND l.PT < 14
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 16;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    l.Date AS test_date,
    l.DNA AS anti_dna_level,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
          WHEN strftime('%m-%d', l.Date) < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday)
          THEN 1 ELSE 0
        END AS age_years,
    COALESCE(e.Diagnosis, p.Diagnosis) AS diagnosis
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  LEFT JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Admission = '+'
    AND l.DNA IS NOT NULL
    AND trim(l.DNA) <> ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           ORDER BY CAST(anti_dna_level AS REAL) DESC, test_date ASC, patient_id ASC
         ) AS rn
  FROM candidates
)
SELECT patient_id, test_date, anti_dna_level, age_years, diagnosis
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" >= 1.2
  AND lower(p.Diagnosis) LIKE '%systemic lupus erythematosus%'
  AND lower(p.Diagnosis) NOT LIKE '%susp%'
ORDER BY p.SEX, p.ID;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT
    ID,
    CASE
      WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 'Admitted to the hospital'
      WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 'Followed at the outpatient clinic'
    END AS care_setting
  FROM Patient
  WHERE SEX = 'F'
    AND Admission IN ('+', '-')
    AND date(Birthday, '+50 years') <= date('2026-10-09')
),
patient_status AS (
  SELECT
    e.ID,
    e.care_setting,
    MAX(CASE WHEN CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_elevated
  FROM eligible AS e
  LEFT JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID
  GROUP BY e.ID, e.care_setting
)
SELECT
  care_setting,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_at_least_one_rnp_result_ge_4,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_elevated = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS patients_with_no_such_result
FROM patient_status
GROUP BY care_setting
ORDER BY care_setting;

WITH cohort AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Examination
  WHERE Thrombosis = 1
),
latest AS (
  SELECT l.ID, MAX(l.Date) AS visit_date
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN cohort c ON c.ID = l.ID
  GROUP BY l.ID
),
strongly_positive AS (
  SELECT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN latest v ON v.ID = l.ID AND v.visit_date = l.Date
  WHERE CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 32
)
SELECT COALESCE(
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN -1 ELSE 0 END),
  0
) AS female_minus_male
FROM strongly_positive s
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = s.ID;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
JOIN (
  SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS latest_date
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
) latest ON latest.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory l
  ON l.ID = latest.ID
 AND l.Date = latest.latest_date
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 64
  AND l.CPK < 250;

WITH confirmed_sle AS (
  SELECT ID, Admission
  FROM Patient
  WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%susp%'
),
care AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN Admission IN ('+', '-') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS care_setting_count
  FROM confirmed_sle
)
SELECT
  inpatient_count,
  outpatient_count,
  ROUND(100.0 * inpatient_count / NULLIF(care_setting_count, 0), 2) AS inpatient_percentage
FROM care;

WITH qualified AS (
  SELECT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  GROUP BY ID
  HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN LDH >= 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1
     AND MAX(CASE
       WHEN UPPER(TRIM("U-PRO")) GLOB '>=*'
         AND CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM("U-PRO"), 3) AS REAL) >= 100 THEN 1
       WHEN UPPER(TRIM("U-PRO")) GLOB '*(*'
         AND CAST(SUBSTR(TRIM("U-PRO"), INSTR(TRIM("U-PRO"), '(') + 1) AS REAL) >= 100 THEN 1
       ELSE 0
     END) = 1
)
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN qualified AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
ORDER BY p.ID;

SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
WHERE p.SEX IN ('F', 'M')
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Examination AS e
    WHERE e.ID = p.ID
  )
GROUP BY p.SEX
ORDER BY p.SEX;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'F'
  AND "First Date" >= '1998-01-01'
  AND "First Date" < '1999-01-01'
  AND Admission LIKE '+%'

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID AS patient_id,
    p.Birthday,
    p.Diagnosis AS overall_diagnosis,
    e."Examination Date" AS examination_date,
    e.Symptoms AS symptom
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
  WHERE e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%'
    AND e.Diagnosis NOT LIKE '%SLE%susp%'
    AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(e.Symptoms) <> ''
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    symptom,
    overall_diagnosis,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY Birthday ASC, patient_id ASC, examination_date DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM qualifying
)
SELECT symptom, overall_diagnosis
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1;

SELECT ROUND(AVG("aCL IgM"), 1) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Examination
WHERE "Examination Date" >= '1993-10-01'
  AND "Examination Date" < '1993-11-01'
  AND Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%';

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ID
  FROM Laboratory
  WHERE RBC < 3.5
),
patient_ages AS (
  SELECT
    p.ID,
    p.Admission,
    CAST(strftime('%Y', '2026-10-09') AS INTEGER)
      - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
      - CASE
          WHEN strftime('%m-%d', '2026-10-09') < strftime('%m-%d', p.Birthday) THEN 1
          ELSE 0
        END AS age
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN qualifying_patients AS q ON q.ID = p.ID
)
SELECT
  Admission AS care_setting,
  COUNT(*) AS patient_count,
  ROUND(AVG(age), 1) AS average_completed_age
FROM patient_ages
WHERE Admission IN ('+', '-')
GROUP BY Admission
ORDER BY Admission DESC;

SELECT ROUND(AVG(e."aCL IgM"), 2) AS average_acl_igm
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND e."aCL IgM" IS NOT NULL
  AND e."aCL IgM" <> 0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patients_with_sjs
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(p.SEX)) IN ('female', 'f')
  AND e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SjS%'
  AND LOWER(e.Diagnosis) NOT LIKE '%suspect%';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS patient_count
FROM Patient p
WHERE (p.Admission IS NULL OR TRIM(p.Admission) = ''
       OR LOWER(TRIM(p.Admission)) IN ('no', 'none', 'never', 'outpatient'))
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM Laboratory l
    WHERE l.ID = p.ID
      AND l.RNP IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        LOWER(TRIM(l.RNP)) IN ('negative', 'neg', '0', '0.0')
        OR CAST(TRIM(l.RNP) AS REAL) = 0
      )
  );

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  GROUP BY l.ID
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(TRIM(l.SM)) IN ('negative', '0') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 1
     AND SUM(CASE
               WHEN l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL
                AND UPPER(TRIM(l.`U-PRO`)) NOT IN ('-', 'TR', 'NEGATIVE', '0', '')
                AND CAST(TRIM(l.`U-PRO`) AS REAL) >= 30
               THEN 1 ELSE 0
             END) >= 1
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT q.ID) AS patient_count
FROM qualifying_patients AS q
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM Examination AS e
  WHERE e.ID = q.ID
    AND e.Thrombosis IS NOT NULL
    AND e.Thrombosis <> 0
);

WITH qualifying_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
         p.ID,
         (julianday('2026-10-09') - julianday(p.Birthday)) / 365.2425 AS age_years
  FROM Patient AS p
  JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.Birthday IS NOT NULL
    AND julianday('2026-10-09') < julianday(p.Birthday, '+70 years')
    AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) >= 64
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(age_years), 1) AS average_age_years
FROM qualifying_patients;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS female_patient_count
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.WBC > 3.5
  AND l.WBC < 9.0
  AND (l.FG <= 150 OR l.FG >= 450)
  AND CAST(l.RNP AS REAL) > 15;

WITH eligible AS (
  SELECT p.ID, p.SEX
  FROM Patient AS p
  WHERE p.Birthday >= '1936-01-01'
    AND p.Birthday < '1957-01-01'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM Laboratory AS l
      WHERE l.ID = p.ID
        AND l.CPK >= 250
    )
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(SEX)) IN ('F', 'FEMALE', 'WOMAN', 'WOMEN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS women,
    SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(TRIM(SEX)) IN ('M', 'MALE', 'MAN', 'MEN') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS men
  FROM eligible
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * women / NULLIF(women + men, 0), 1) AS women_percentage
FROM counts;

WITH qualifying AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT l.ID
  FROM Laboratory AS l
  JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID
  WHERE l.Date >= '1981-01-01'
    AND l.Date < '1987-01-01'
    AND l.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400
    AND l."U-PRO" IS NOT NULL
    AND TRIM(l."U-PRO") <> ''
    AND UPPER(TRIM(l."U-PRO")) NOT IN ('-', '0', '0.0', '0.00')
    AND (
      (
        CAST(strftime('%m%d', l.Date) AS INTEGER) >=
        CAST(strftime('%m%d', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        AND CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) -
            CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) < 50
      )
      OR (
        CAST(strftime('%m%d', l.Date) AS INTEGER) <
        CAST(strftime('%m%d', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)
        AND CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) -
            CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) - 1 < 50
      )
    )
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS patient_count
FROM qualifying;

WITH single_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
oxygen_counts AS (
  SELECT sbm.molecule_id,
         COUNT(CASE WHEN a.element = 'O' THEN 1 END) AS oxygen_count
  FROM single_bond_molecules AS sbm
  LEFT JOIN atom AS a
    ON a.molecule_id = sbm.molecule_id
  GROUP BY sbm.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(AVG(oxygen_count), 4) AS average_oxygen_atoms_per_molecule
FROM oxygen_counts;

WITH single_bond_counts AS (
  SELECT m.molecule_id, COUNT(*) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '+'
    AND b.bond_type = '-'
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id
)
SELECT AVG(single_bond_count) AS average_single_bonds_per_molecule
FROM single_bond_counts;

WITH element_counts AS (
  SELECT a.element, COUNT(*) AS atom_occurrences
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
  WHERE m.label = '-'
  GROUP BY a.element
),
minimum_count AS (
  SELECT MIN(atom_occurrences) AS min_occurrences
  FROM element_counts
)
SELECT element, atom_occurrences
FROM element_counts
WHERE atom_occurrences = (SELECT min_occurrences FROM minimum_count)
ORDER BY element;

WITH carcinogenic AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
),
molecule_fluorine AS (
  SELECT c.molecule_id,
         MAX(CASE WHEN a.element = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_fluorine
  FROM carcinogenic c
  LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = c.molecule_id
  GROUP BY c.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(
         100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN has_fluorine = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*),
         2
       ) AS percentage_no_fluorine
FROM molecule_fluorine;

WITH bond_counts AS (
  SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
  FROM bond
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR010'
  GROUP BY bond_type
),
ranked_bonds AS (
  SELECT bond_type,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY bond_count DESC, bond_type) AS rn
  FROM bond_counts
)
SELECT rb.bond_type,
       CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END AS carcinogenic
FROM molecule AS m
LEFT JOIN ranked_bonds AS rb ON rb.rn = 1
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR010';

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM bond
    WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
phosphorus_or_bromine_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
    FROM atom
    WHERE element IN ('P', 'Br')
),
qualifying_molecules AS (
    SELECT t.molecule_id
    FROM triple_bond_molecules AS t
    JOIN phosphorus_or_bromine_molecules AS p
      ON p.molecule_id = t.molecule_id
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN qualifying_molecules AS q
  ON q.molecule_id = a.molecule_id;

WITH qualifying_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '-'
),
counts AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS total_atoms,
    SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'Cl' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS chlorine_atoms
  FROM atom AS a
  JOIN qualifying_molecules AS q
    ON a.molecule_id = q.molecule_id
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * chlorine_atoms / NULLIF(total_atoms, 0), 4) AS chlorine_percentage
FROM counts;

WITH bond_status AS (
  SELECT
    m.molecule_id,
    m.label,
    COUNT(b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS single_bond_count
  FROM molecule AS m
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  GROUP BY m.molecule_id, m.label
),
grouped AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN bond_count > 0 AND bond_count = single_bond_count
        THEN 'every bond is single'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS bond_group,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS carcinogenic_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_carcinogenic_count
  FROM bond_status
  GROUP BY bond_group
)
SELECT
  bond_group,
  carcinogenic_count,
  non_carcinogenic_count,
  carcinogenic_count - non_carcinogenic_count AS count_difference
FROM grouped
ORDER BY CASE bond_group WHEN 'every bond is single' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS carbon_carbon_double_bond_pairs
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN bond AS b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id AND a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
  AND b.bond_type = '='
  AND a1.element = 'C'
  AND a2.element = 'C';

WITH carcinogenic AS (
  SELECT molecule_id
  FROM molecule
  WHERE label = '+'
),
carbon_bonds AS (
  SELECT b.bond_type
  FROM carcinogenic m
  JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id AND a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2 AND a2.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
  WHERE a1.element = 'C' AND a2.element = 'C'
)
SELECT bond_type, COUNT(*) AS count
FROM carbon_bonds
WHERE bond_type IN ('-', '=', '#')
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY CASE bond_type WHEN '-' THEN 1 WHEN '=' THEN 2 WHEN '#' THEN 3 END;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id2 WHEN a2.element = 'cl' THEN c.atom_id END) AS count_atoms_bonded_to_chlorine
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl' OR a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS sulfur_direct_bonded_atoms
FROM atom AS sulfur
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = sulfur.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = sulfur.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = sulfur.atom_id
WHERE sulfur.element = 's'
  AND m.label = '+';

WITH rare_element_molecules AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a1.molecule_id
    FROM atom AS a1
    WHERE a1.element IS NOT NULL
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM atom AS a2
          WHERE a2.element = a1.element
            AND a2.molecule_id <> a1.molecule_id
      )
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_id, b.molecule_id
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m
  ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN rare_element_molecules AS r
  ON r.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
ORDER BY b.bond_id, b.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS molecule_count
FROM molecule AS m
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS n
    WHERE n.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND n.element = 'n'
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM atom AS n
    JOIN connected AS c
      ON c.atom_id = n.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = n.atom_id
    JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
    WHERE n.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
      AND n.element = 'n'
      AND b.bond_type IN ('=', '#')
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.atom_id2) AS atom_count
FROM atom AS chlorine
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = chlorine.atom_id
WHERE LOWER(chlorine.element) = 'cl';

WITH triple_bond_molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT molecule_id
  FROM bond
  WHERE bond_type = '#'
),
classified AS (
  SELECT m.label
  FROM molecule AS m
  JOIN triple_bond_molecules AS t USING (molecule_id)
  WHERE m.label IN ('+', '-')
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS carcinogenic_percent,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*), 2) AS non_carcinogenic_percent
FROM classified;

WITH element_molecule_counts AS (
    SELECT element, COUNT(DISTINCT molecule_id) AS molecule_count
    FROM atom
    WHERE molecule_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY element
),
rare_elements AS (
    SELECT element
    FROM element_molecule_counts
    WHERE molecule_count = 1
),
carcinogenic_rare_atoms AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, a.atom_id
    FROM molecule AS m
    JOIN atom AS a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
    JOIN rare_elements AS r ON r.element = a.element
    WHERE m.label = '+'
)
SELECT cra.molecule_id, COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count
FROM carcinogenic_rare_atoms AS cra
LEFT JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.atom_id = cra.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = cra.atom_id
GROUP BY cra.molecule_id
ORDER BY cra.molecule_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS hydrogen_bond_count
FROM atom AS yttrium
JOIN atom AS hydrogen
  ON hydrogen.molecule_id = yttrium.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c
  ON c.atom_id = hydrogen.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = hydrogen.atom_id
WHERE yttrium.element = 'Y'
  AND hydrogen.element = 'H';

SELECT a2.element, COUNT(*) AS bond_count
FROM molecule AS m
JOIN atom AS a1 ON a1.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected AS c ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a1.element = 'C'
  AND b.bond_type IN ('double', 'triple')
GROUP BY a2.element
ORDER BY a2.element;

WITH target AS (
  SELECT molecule_id, label
  FROM molecule
  WHERE molecule_id = 'TR377'
),
bond_profile AS (
  SELECT
    b.bond_type AS bond_kind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT b.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
      WHEN a1.element <= a2.element THEN a1.element || '|' || a2.element
      ELSE a2.element || '|' || a1.element
    END) AS element_pair_count
  FROM target t
  JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = t.molecule_id
  JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
  JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
  JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
  WHERE b.bond_type IN ('-', '=')
  GROUP BY b.bond_type
)
SELECT
  p.bond_kind,
  p.bond_count,
  p.element_pair_count,
  t.label AS carcinogenicity_label
FROM bond_profile p
JOIN target t
ORDER BY p.bond_count DESC, p.bond_kind ASC;

WITH atom_bonds AS (
  SELECT
    a.atom_id,
    a.element,
    COUNT(c.bond_id) AS bond_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '-' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS non_single_bond_count
  FROM atom AS a
  LEFT JOIN connected AS c
    ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
  LEFT JOIN bond AS b
    ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  GROUP BY a.atom_id, a.element
)
SELECT
  element AS element_symbol,
  COUNT(*) AS atom_count
FROM atom_bonds
WHERE bond_count > 0
  AND non_single_bond_count = 0
GROUP BY element
ORDER BY element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element AS element_symbol, COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS molecule_count
FROM atom AS a
WHERE EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM connected AS c
  JOIN bond AS b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
  WHERE (c.atom_id = a.atom_id OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id)
    AND b.bond_type = '#'
)
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY molecule_count DESC, element_symbol ASC;

SELECT a.element, COUNT(DISTINCT a.atom_id) AS bonded_atom_count
FROM atom AS a
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR397'
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM connected AS c
    WHERE c.atom_id = a.atom_id
       OR c.atom_id2 = a.atom_id
  )
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY a.element;
